NAME: Minnie
TEXT: *Minnie is in a foster care home* Foster update: "Minnie can be left alone for a couple of hours, we leave her in our enclosed garden. She has mastered the steps. She has met children (my grand son is 11), she is excellent with kids. Minnie has gone to the café, loves walks & has gone to the field when my grandson plays soccer. We have noticed Minnie loves to be in open spaces, loves raw bones & roast chicken. She has an excellent character. She loves car rides, jumps into the car herself, very well toilet trained, does not bark when left alone, sleeps through the night, suits apartment living, loves one walk a day" ---------- Minnie is a sweet, bubbly girl. Minnie is friendly, affectionate, a tad goofy, and oh so lovable! Minnie is a great blend of silly and calm, being middle aged she's ready to kick off her lounge lizard era, and can't wait to meet you! A home with a yard to perfect her zoomies, and some children to entertain her after school, would be a great fit. She also suits apartment living due to enjoying being indoors, being toilet trained, and happy to sit inside with you. In return Minnie promises to keep everyone upbeat and having fun every day. This gorgeous girl can be adopted at our Western Sydney Adoption Centre.

NAME: Clavell
TEXT: Clavell is a gentle, shy girl who has been living as a pet while awaiting her forever home. In this time she has learnt toilet training, sleeps indoors, and has spent time with kids aged 12 and 14. She is low confidence at heart and needs time and patience to feel safe. Clavell is best suited to a calm, experienced home that can give her the time and understanding she needs to build confidence and feel secure. She would love a backyard and a home without loud/excitable kids. Meet Clavell at Western Sydney,

NAME: Carrie
TEXT: Carrie is a sweet, shy girl who needs time to warm up to new humans. She would benefit from a quieter home with a gentle approach to introducing her to all things pet life. Carrie likes the simple things, being outdoors, the sunshine, playing with a ball or sunbaking. She also loves water. Carrie is a gentle, middle-aged girl with a calm, mostly independent nature. She enjoys quietly exploring her surroundings and is happy doing her own thing, making her a great match for someone looking for a laid back, low maintenance type pet. Carrie is polite around other larger dogs and can live with a medium to large dog. She walks beautifully on lead and is generally easy to handle, though she can be shy. Carrie will thrive in a calm, predictable home where she can settle in at her own pace. Meet Carrie at Western Sydney!

NAME: Yoko
TEXT: Yoko is a friendly and curious, bubbly greyhound with a sweet, wiggly greeting and a love of human company. She walks well on lead, comes when called, and enjoys meeting new people. In new environments, Yoko can be a little excited at first but settles as she grows more comfortable. She is happy to mingle with other dogs her size and can be rehomed with medium to large dogs. She also loves the water! Yoko is a lovely girl who will thrive in a calm, supportive home where she can have an outlet for fun, games and enrichment, and a family who will support her confident bubbly nature. Meet Yoko at Western Sydney.

NAME: Slim
TEXT: Meet Slim! Slim is a young greyhound who has decided that the pet life is definitely for him. As a young dog, he will benefit from some ongoing training and guidance, and he is a strong, active boy who will enjoy regular exercise and mental stimulation. Slim has met small dogs and has been polite and friendly in his interactions. He has adorable lopsided ears, which certainly don’t stop him from hearing the crinkle of a biscuit packet or the jingle of a treat pouch. Slim is a real stickybeak who loves to be involved in whatever is happening around him and enjoys being part of the action. With the right home willing to invest time in his training and include him in daily life, Slim will make a fun and rewarding companion.

NAME: Maddie
TEXT: Little 25kg Maddie is friendly to kids, and has a quiet and gentle personality. She had a docile and shy personality, and would suit a quiet lifestyle to begin her adoption journey. A backyard or townhouse is best suited so she can enjoy some peace and quiet when needed. She is gentle with other dogs his size, and can live alongside respectful children as she has had some exposure to kids before. Maddie is a sweet girl who will thrive as a pet in a calm and understanding home! Meet Maddie at Western Sydney.

NAME: Jamima
TEXT: Jamima 🖤 Jamima is a sweet, easy-going girl who’s happy doing her own thing while still being close to her people. She has a calm, independent nature and is more than content to potter around, find a comfy spot, and settle in for a good chill. While she enjoys her quiet time, Jamima is also a gentle companion who will happily come over for pats and share those soft, special moments with you. She’s the perfect balance of independent and affectionate never demanding, just quietly lovely to have around. If you’re looking for a low-key, sweet girl who will fit seamlessly into your home, Jamima might just be your perfect match.

NAME: Dom
TEXT: Meet Dom, an energetic and excitable young man, he will keep you entertained with his antics and happy personality. Whether it's zooming, finding toys and playing with them, exploring the garden or getting cuddles, Dom is all about fun and games. Dom would suit a family with older children who have an active lifestyle. An owner who can walk a stronger dog on the leash would be a great fit as he still has excitable moments on the lead when you first get going, but calms nicely. A backyard is a must for Leo as he is itching to get out and about. He's learnt his name, and also mingles nicely with other dogs his size. If you're looking for a confident, charming boy, meet handsome Dom at Western Sydney,

NAME: Beauty
TEXT: Beauty 🖤 True to her name, Beauty is a gentle, calming soul who will quietly steal your heart. With her cutest floppy ears and soft, loving nature, she’s happiest when she’s by your side soaking up pats and affection. She’s an easy-going girl who doesn’t ask for much, just a comfy spot, kind company, and plenty of cuddles. Whether it’s lounging around the house or enjoying a relaxed day with her humans, Beauty is more than happy to simply hang out and be your loyal companion. If you’re looking for a sweet, affectionate girl with a peaceful presence, Beauty is your perfect match.

NAME: Snow
TEXT: Meet Snow – Your Happy, Gentle Companion! '🐾💙 Snow is a handsome, affectionate young lad who’s ready to bring love and laughter into his forever home. With his easy going nature and friendly personality, Snow quickly wins over everyone he meets. He’s wonderful on the lead, making walks a breeze, and he absolutely adores getting out and about for daily adventures. Snow is especially fond of people and thrives on attention - whether it’s pats, cuddles, being dressed up by the kids or simply being by your side. He’s great with children aged 6–11 and has a gentle, calm demeanor that makes him a lovely family companion. At home, he gets along beautifully with a pet Dachshund and other retired greyhounds. This sweet boy would love to be part of a family lifestyle. He enjoys car rides, tagging along for school pick-ups and going on walks. Snow is happiest when he’s included in everyday moments, soaking up the love and sharing his cheerful spirit.

NAME: Branch
TEXT: Are you looking to BRANCH out this Autumn? Meet Branch, our sweet, shy, small animal social greyhound here at GAP HQ. Branch is a quiet, reserved boy who would suit an owner who can nurture a shy greyhound out of their shell. Indoor cats, understanding dogs of any size (small or large) are welcome in Branch's new home! We would love to see Branch go into an experienced greyhound owners' home with a quiet lifestyle and a backyard with secure fencing where he can retreat to and enjoy the peace and quiet away from people when he needs it. A home without young kids is ideal, however experienced teenagers would be suitable. If you are someone who can provide a shy dog the structure, support, and ongoing confidence training that he needs to thrive as a pet, we'd love to hear from you. Meet Branch at Western Sydney!

NAME: Hanno
TEXT: Meet Hanno - your gentle giant with the softest soul 💛 Hanno is a big, beautiful boy with an even bigger heart. True to his gentle nature, he absolutely adores people and will happily rest his head on your lap for pats, cuddles, and all the love you can give. He has a sweet, easygoing temperament and is just as happy playing with his toys as he is lounging around and soaking up a quiet moment with you. Whether it’s a little playtime or a lazy afternoon on the couch, Hanno is simply content being by your side. If you’re looking for a calm, affectionate companion Hanno might just be your perfect match 🐾

NAME: Boots
TEXT: Shine your boots and walk on in to our centre to come and meet me and take me home....Hi, my name is Boots and I'm a very sweet girl who would love to find a calm, patient family to help me truly shine. I get a bit nervous sometimes meeting new people but if you show me I can be respected and loved I will be your best friend. I would love to have a chilled out canine buddy who can show me the best things in life and be my guide if I find new things to learn about. I also wouldn't mind living with a cat if we get to know each other slowly. I would be best suited to a home with a yard but I might also like an apartment as long as my home environment is quiet and calm. I don't mind having alone time but would appreciate someone willing to work up to leaving me alone for a long time. If you think you might be the special person to take me on my new adventure, I'd sure love to meet you! Available at Londonderry, at Western Sydney.

NAME: Jetta
TEXT: Jetta is a happy, affectionate girl who would make a wonderful addition to almost any home. She thrives on human companionship and absolutely loves being around people, always ready to share her cheerful energy and cuddly nature. As long as she gets her regular walks and daily exercise, Jetta adapts well to different living environments. Whether it’s a busy household or a quieter space, she brings warmth, joy, and a loving presence wherever she goes. With her friendly personality and bright spirit, Jetta is sure to win hearts and become a loyal, loving companion.

NAME: Archie
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Archie Archie is a confident and curious greyhound who enjoys getting out and exploring the world around him. On walks, he is easy to handle, happily moving along at a relaxed pace while taking in all the sights and smells. He’s a friendly boy who will say hello and enjoys attention, though he’s just as content following his nose and exploring his surroundings. Archie has a more independent nature, making him a great match for someone who appreciates a dog that enjoys both company and doing his own thing. Archie travels calmly and has shown himself to be relaxed in new environments, taking everything in stride. Archie would be best suited to a home without small dogs or cats, where he can feel comfortable and focus on his walks and daily routine. If you’re looking for a laid-back, independent greyhound who enjoys exploring and living life at his own pace, Archie could be a great addition to your home.

NAME: Elvis
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Elvis Elvis is a happy, confident greyhound who brings a fun and enthusiastic energy to everything he does. He enjoys getting out and about, approaching the world with curiosity and excitement, always keen to explore what’s around him. On walks, Elvis can be strong on lead at times, especially when something catches his interest, but he settles into the outing and enjoys a good wander. He’s an engaging companion who likes to be part of the action and see what’s going on. Elvis is very people-friendly and loves affection. He’ll happily come up for pats, wagging his tail and staying close to soak up the attention. He’s also been around children and has shown a positive, social nature. He travels calmly and is comfortable in new environments, taking things in stride while still enjoying the excitement of getting out and about. Elvis would benefit from a home that can continue to guide him on lead and support his enthusiasm. Elvis would be best suited to a home without small dogs or cats, where he can comfortably enjoy his surroundings and focus on his adventures. If you’re looking for a fun, affectionate greyhound who enjoys being out and about and loves a good cuddle, Elvis could be a great match.

NAME: Brax
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Brax Brax is a friendly and confident greyhound with a happy, engaging personality. On walks, he moves with a relaxed, sniff-and-explore style, wagging his tail and showing curiosity about the world around him. He walks well on lead with no pulling, making walks enjoyable for both him and his person. He loves spending time with people, happily coming up for pats and engaging with a wagging tail. Brax has experience around children and is comfortable inside a home environment, showing himself to be calm and relaxed. He is calm in the car and adjusts well to new environments, showing a low-stress, easy-going nature. If you’re looking for a confident, affectionate greyhound who enjoys walks, exploration, and plenty of pats, Brax could be a wonderful addition to your home.

NAME: Hog
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Hog Hog is a confident and friendly young greyhound with a curious and playful nature. On walks, he may start off a little strong with excitement, but he quickly settles into a happy, relaxed pace, happily sniffing and exploring his surroundings. He enjoys human company and is affectionate, happy to receive pats and attention while maintaining his easy-going personality. Hog has started learning to move around indoors and has been exposed to children, showing a positive, adaptable temperament. He is relaxed around small dogs, happily going about his own business. Hog is calm in the car and comfortable in new environments, showing a low-stress, confident attitude. If you’re looking for a playful yet relaxed greyhound who enjoys exploration, pats, and spending time with people, Hog could be a wonderful companion.

NAME: Jaynee
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Jaynee Jaynee is a friendly and relaxed greyhound who enjoys exploring her surroundings at a gentle, happy pace. On walks, she happily sniffs and investigates while staying calm and easy to manage. She loves spending time with people, coming up for pats and wagging her tail as she soaks up attention. Jaynee is content to stay close for affection, making her a sweet and sociable companion. She has shown herself to be calm and easy-going around small dogs, happily going about her own business. Jaynee is also comfortable in the car and adapts well to new environments, showing a steady, relaxed nature. If you’re looking for a gentle, affectionate greyhound who enjoys both quiet exploration and plenty of cuddles, Jaynee could be a wonderful addition to your home.

NAME: Minty
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Minty Minty is a friendly and confident greyhound who enjoys exploring the world at her own pace. On walks, she’s curious and happy to sniff around, sometimes showing a little extra enthusiasm for interesting smells, but she’s always manageable and enjoys taking it all in. She’s very people-oriented and loves attention, happily soaking up pats and affection. Minty has also spent time around children and shows a relaxed attitude towards small dogs, showing herself to be relaxed and gentle. Calm in the car and comfortable in new environments, Minty is a steady, easy-going companion who enjoys both exploration and quiet moments. If you’re looking for a gentle, affectionate greyhound who enjoys walks, sniffing adventures, and plenty of cuddles, Minty could be a perfect addition to your home.

NAME: Cutie
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Cutie Cutie is a cheerful and confident lady who brings a lot of joy wherever she goes. She loves leading the way on walks, sniffing and exploring her surroundings with excitement and a wagging tail. She’s very friendly and enjoys spending time with people, happily soaking up pats and attention. Cutie has experience around children and has shown herself to be calm and happy in their company. She travels well and adjusts easily to new environments, showing a relaxed and happy nature. If you’re looking for a friendly, outgoing greyhound who loves to explore and enjoys lots of cuddles, Cutie could be a wonderful companion.

NAME: Anna
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Anna Anna is a gentle and calm greyhound who enjoys life at an easy pace. On walks, she is well-mannered with no pulling, happily taking her time to explore her surroundings in a relaxed and curious way. She is very friendly and enjoys affection, happily coming up for pats and quietly soaking up attention. Anna is relaxed around small dogs and happily goes about her own business, enjoying her walks and exploring at her own pace. Anna is calm in new environments and travels well, showing a steady, easy-going nature that makes her a lovely companion. If you’re looking for a gentle, affectionate greyhound who enjoys quiet exploration and plenty of cuddles, Anna could be a wonderful addition to your home.

NAME: Rhino
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Rhino Rhino is a confident and independent greyhound with a calm, relaxed demeanour. On walks, he enjoys exploring at his own pace and can be a little strong on lead, showing his enthusiasm for new sights and smells. He approaches the world with curiosity, sniffing and investigating everything around him with quiet confidence. Rhino is an independent thinker who loves to explore and take in his surroundings. He enjoys pats and attention when it’s offered, and is happiest when allowed to discover the world at his own pace. Rhino is a calm and easy-going companion who adjusts well to new environments. He’s happy to share space with small dogs, giving them plenty of room while he goes about his own relaxed explorations. If you’re looking for an independent, confident greyhound who enjoys gentle walks, quiet exploration, and a relaxed lifestyle, Rhino could be a great companion to share your home and adventures with.

NAME: Murray
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Murray Murray is a calm and easy-going greyhound with a gentle, friendly nature. He walks nicely on lead without pulling, happy to take his time having a sniff and quietly exploring his surroundings. He approaches life in a relaxed way, showing a steady confidence in new environments and taking things as they come. Around people, Murray is warm and approachable, he’s happy to come over for a pat and enjoys affection without being over the top. Murray travels calmly and has shown himself to be low-stress and settled in different situations so far. He has also shown positive, relaxed behaviour around small dogs. Murray may suit a range of homes, particularly those looking for a laid-back and gentle companion. He would enjoy regular walks, a comfortable place to rest, and plenty of pats and quiet company. If you’re after a relaxed, friendly greyhound who enjoys a simple life of strolls, naps, and affection, Murray could be a lovely addition to the right home.

NAME: Happy
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Happy Happy is a bright, energetic girl who truly lives up to her name. She approaches life with enthusiasm, bouncing into new environments with confidence, curiosity, and a wagging tail. On walks, she’s active and playful without being a strong puller, enjoying a good explore while keeping things fun and engaging. She’s very people-oriented and loves attention, Happy will happily come up for pats and soak up all the affection on offer. Her cheerful, affectionate nature makes her a lovely companion for someone who enjoys a dog with a bit of personality and spark. Happy travels well and has shown low stress in new situations, taking everything in stride with her upbeat attitude. She would suit a home that can match her energy and continue to guide her as she settles into a routine. Happy would be best suited to a home without small animals, including small dogs, cats, or birds. If you’re looking for a fun, affectionate greyhound who brings a bit of bounce to your day and plenty of love to your home, Happy could be a great match.

NAME: Butters
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Butters Butters is a happy, confident greyhound who brings a lovely mix of curiosity and affection to everything he does. On walks, he enjoys a bit of a zig-zag adventure, taking in all the interesting smells around him, but he’s also great at checking back in with his handler, making him both engaging and easy to walk. He approaches the world with a relaxed confidence, happily exploring new environments with a wagging tail and an upbeat attitude. Around people, Butters is just as charming, he’ll come over for a pat and is more than content to stay close, soaking up all the attention. He’s the kind of dog who genuinely enjoys company and will make the most of any affection on offer. Butters travels calmly and has shown himself to be settled and low-stress in different situations so far. He may suit a variety of homes, especially those looking for a friendly, interactive companion who enjoys both exploring and relaxing. If you’re after a cheerful, affectionate greyhound who loves a good wander followed by plenty of pats, Butters could be a wonderful match.

NAME: Freya
TEXT: Meet Freya 💛 Freya is a happy-go-lucky girl with a lovely, placid nature. She absolutely loves people and greets everyone with a wagging tail and a warm, gentle presence that instantly makes you feel at ease. This sweet girl is quiet and affectionate, happiest when she’s by your side - whether that’s enjoying a leisurely walk or simply relaxing together at home. Freya walks beautifully on lead, staying close and calmly taking in the world around her. Freya gets along well with small dogs (she’s spent time with the family Mini Groodle and Kelpie cross) and is wonderful with children aged 7 and up. Her placid temperament and easy-care nature make her a joy to have around. If you’re looking for a gentle, loving companion or a loyal family pet, Freya could be the perfect match. She’s ready to bring warmth, calm, and plenty of tail wags into her forever home. 🐾

NAME: Zena
TEXT: *Zena has just gone to foster with a Borzoi in an apartment - update below!* "Zena is still anxious around unknown people and in new situations. We have brought her along to various football matches without problem, but she needs a little time to observe from a distance before going closer. The same applies to new situations. She gets on well with our dog and we haven't seen any problematic behaviour around other dogs. Zena is very playful and has started to pick up toys, although she doesn't quite know what to do with them once she's picked them up. She has managed to play tug-of-war with our dog a couple of times and they generally play well together. Overall, Zena is a very affectionate little dog (once she knows and trusts you) that would make a lovely pet, but perhaps in a quieter household." ----------- Zena is a happy, friendly girl, who would suit a nurturing, calm household to really thrive into the cheeky, confident girl we've seen here at the adoption centre! She can take a little time to adapt and feel comfortable in new environments and requires understanding pawrents willing to take new things slow. A home without kids would support her confidence the best. Zena socialises well with other dogs around her size and she doesn't mind if it's dog or human, but she would love some company during the day. Zena's favourite activity is settling down in a cozy area while enjoying a Kong or a food puzzle, since treats are her favourite thing! She is phenomenal with her training here at GAP HQ - she has learned how to navigate stairs, responds to her name, knows "down", "touch" a hand target, "shake" and even "sit" which is a tricky one for most greyhounds! What a clever girl! Zena is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre so let us know if you are interested in taking her home!

NAME: Custard
TEXT: Meet Custard! 💛 Custard is a beautiful friendly boy, the colour of creamy custard and just as delicious! He's a smart cookie who can get the backdoor open and work his way inside and onto the sofa, and especially loves riding around in the Winnebago! King of the road! He is outgoing and very affectionate, adoring the company of his people. He'll greet you with excitement and a wagging tail, making you feel loved every day. He enjoys the company of the grandchildren from 6 months to 12 years old, socializing with other greys, and lying in the back yard with the pet fox terriers, basking in the sun. Custard is well-behaved on street walks and easy to manage on lead once he has got over his excitement of seeing you. He'll happily settle by your side calmly and be a loyal companion or family pet. He loves a bath and is also comfortable around aviary birds in the backyard. This lovable boy would be a perfect fit for an active couple or a family with older kids/grandkids and happily cohabit with other dogs. Mr. Custard is all smiles & a bit of a character, guaranteed to bring you plenty of joy. 🥰🐾

NAME: Libby
TEXT: Libby is a gorgeous girl with a playful spirit and the sweetest nature. She loves having fun, whether that’s zooming around the yard or sharing gentle moments with her people. Libby is especially comfortable around other medium to large dogs and enjoys their company, making her a great match for a home with larger canine friends. True to her cheerful personality, Libby has a cheeky habit of jumping up when she gets excited, it’s her way of saying hello and showing how happy she is to see you. With a little guidance, this enthusiasm will easily turn into beautifully polite greetings. Affectionate, lively, and full of charm, Libby is sure to bring laughter, love, and plenty of tail wags to her forever home.

NAME: Dakota
TEXT: Dakota is so beautiful and charismatic, we know she will steal your heart as soon as you meet her! Dakota recently had a weekend vacation at a staff member's home and she was the perfect houseguest! She was confident and resilient learning a new place and routine, she was excellent with toileting and slept soundly through the night with no issues! She spent few hours alone indoors and just snoozed away until the humans returned - what a good girl! Dakota is on the active side for a greyhound and she really enjoyed longer walks where she got to do lots of sniffing on the longline. She also loves a good play with toys and enrichment activities throughout the day and would be well suited for someone looking for a fun-loving companion confident enough to join them on their social outings. Apartments/units are suitable as long as you are willing to spend some quality play/walk time with her daily. Older kids are suitable and would enjoy her goofy nature! Dakota is friendly and sociable with other medium-large size dogs and greets and plays with them nicely. She loves her food and is highly trainable, having already mastered longline recall, "down" and "off". This outgoing girl can't wait to join you on all your adventures! Apply online to add Dakota to your family.

NAME: Jimmothy
TEXT: Goofy little Jimmothy will steal your heart and never give it back! “I’ve just starred in foster care and now I’m looking for my special home!” ✨ Jimmothy is suitable for full-time workers and was content in foster living in an apartment, where his family was away from 7am to 4pm. He stayed indoors during the day and has shown he can settle beautifully, with perfect toilet training—making him a great fit for apartment living and busy households. His fosters say he is ‘fantastic alone’ and gets so excited when you get home! Jimmothy is a super funny and adorable guy who will have you in stitches 24/7! He enjoys a spontaneous zoomie and gives the best cuddles in the world! As soon as you sit on the floor or the couch, he is right there next to you laying on your lap asking for pats. He loves other dogs, big and small, and would gladly join a family with other dogs in the picture. He loves being indoors but would also enjoy a small courtyard or backyard to stretch his legs and toss his toys around. Respectful kids who can give him his chill time will adore his cuddly, playful nature. Jimmothy truly is one-of-a-kind and we know he is going to bring you joy every day! Submit an application to meet our special boy, Jimmothy!

NAME: Bear
TEXT: Bear is a gorgeous greyhound with a big heart and an even bigger love of life. He absolutely loves riding in the car and is always happy to head out for an adventure. Toys are another favourite — Bear enjoys playtime and will happily entertain himself or invite you to join in. Bear can be a little shy when he first meets new people, but once he feels comfortable, his true personality shines through. When he gets to know you, Bear will quickly become a loyal and affectionate best friend. He’s an active boy who enjoys playing, which means he’s best suited to living with medium to large dogs only, with a good introduction. He can be a bit too enthusiastic for small dogs as he just wants to play and interact. Despite his playful energy, Bear is good with polite children who understand how to give dogs space and respect their boundaries. Bear is looking for a home that will give him time to settle, enjoy his playful side, and include him as part of the family. With patience, love, and a few toys, Bear will reward you with endless loyalty and companionship.

NAME: Hunter
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Hunter 🐾 Hunter is a lovely, easy‑going greyhound who is ready to find his forever home. He has been well socialised with children as young as 2 years old and would suit a home with polite, dog‑savvy kids who understand how to interact respectfully with dogs. Hunter loves getting out and about and enjoys his daily walks. He walks nicely on lead and is inquisitive without being overwhelming, making him a pleasure to handle. He also has a fun side — especially when water is involved — and happily splashes around whenever he gets the chance! He gets along well with other dogs and would be happy living with a canine companion or as an only dog with regular social interaction. Overall, Hunter is an adaptable, relaxed, and friendly boy who will settle easily into a range of home environments. Hunter is looking for a home where he can enjoy his walks, spend time with his people, and be included as part of the family.

NAME: Scout
TEXT: This beautiful girl is great company, she is gentle and affectionate, comes when called and easy to walk on the lead. She is a very relaxed girl who has had inside experience.

NAME: Buddy
TEXT: Buddy is a good boy, he is happy while your out and is social and confident. He has grown up around domestic farm animals, he has been around the young pups and has seen the local native animals that come past.

NAME: Primero
TEXT: Meet Primero, a kind greyhound with a laid-back and easygoing nature. He’s the kind of dog who enjoys life at his own pace, whether that’s chilling in the yard, settling in the car for a ride, or soaking up a gentle pat from a human friend. Primero is affectionate and confident—he happily comes over for attention and responds with calm, friendly energy. He also travels well ready to explore new places with his people. This kind-hearted boy would thrive in a home where he can enjoy companionship, gentle walks, and lots of love from humans who appreciate a dog with a steady, friendly nature.

NAME: Henry
TEXT: Meet Henry, a charming greyhound full of playful personality. Henry is a confident and happy boy who loves to explore and play wherever he goes. On the lead, he can be strong at first, but he quickly settles and walks nicely once he finds his rhythm. He enjoys car rides and is happy to travel to new adventures, though he can bark if things pass close to the car, he just wants to make sure everyone is safe! Henry is incredibly friendly and super excited to meet new people. He adores attention and loves to engage, making him a perfect companion for a family who enjoys an active, playful friend. He’s used to being around children and has been a happy, gentle playmate, sharing his joyful energy without hesitation. Henry is a confident, social, and affectionate boy ready to join a loving home. He thrives on human companionship and is looking for a family to play with, cuddle with, and bring endless smiles to every day. Henry is ready to bring his playful spirit, wagging tail, and happy heart to his forever family, filling their lives with fun, laughter, and love.

NAME: Blondie
TEXT: Meet Blondie, a sweet greyhound with a gentle and affectionate personality. Blondie is a calm and friendly girl who enjoys exploring her surroundings at her own pace. She can be a little strong on the lead at first but settles quickly and walks nicely once comfortable. She travels well in the car and is happy to relax on the way to new adventures. Blondie absolutely adores people and is always ready to come over for a pat, soaking up all the attention she can get. She is wonderful with kids, happy to share her love and affection with the whole family. Blondie has been around cats at home, and is friendly with all dogs big and small, she enjoys a polite hello and quickly settles. She would love a canine friend to share her adventures with. With her calm, affectionate nature and friendly, social personality, Blondie is ready to step into a loving home and bring joy to her new family every day.

NAME: Digger
TEXT: Meet Digger, a playful and confident 5-year-old greyhound who loves being part of the action. Digger is an energetic and friendly boy who enjoys exploring his surroundings and having fun while staying responsive and easy to manage. He’s confident, playful, and happy to come when called. He’s affectionate and loves a pat, often seeking out attention from his humans. On lead, Digger is excitable but controllable, making walks enjoyable for those who like a happy, lively companion. He travels well in the car and is relaxed during outings. Digger gets along well with other greyhounds and has been exposed to small dogs on his property, showing no interest in them. With his confident, playful nature and love for pats, Digger is ready to join a loving home and bring joy every day.

NAME: Dixon
TEXT: Meet Dixon, a sweet black greyhound with a calm and gentle personality. Dixon is a relaxed and easygoing boy who enjoys exploring his surroundings at his own pace. He’s confident but calm, taking new environments in stride and happy to sniff around while staying composed. He’s affectionate and approachable, happily coming over when called and enjoying quiet attention. Dixon gets along well with other greyhounds and shows no interest in small dogs, preferring to keep his own space. On lead, Dixon is well-mannered and relaxed, making walks enjoyable. He also travels calmly in the car. Dixon would thrive in a home where he can enjoy a calm, stable environment, with people who appreciate his gentle and easygoing nature.

NAME: Duke
TEXT: Meet Duke, a stand out greyhound with a laid-back personality and a heart of gold. Duke is the definition of an easygoing companion. Often described as a bit of a “dude,” he takes life in stride with a relaxed, happy attitude. He enjoys having a sniff and a wander but is just as content to cruise along and take things slow. He’s friendly and approachable, happily coming up for pats and enjoying quiet affection. Duke has a calm, gentle presence that makes him a lovely dog to have around the home. On lead, Duke is relaxed and easy to handle, walking along without fuss. He travels well and remains calm in the car, making outings simple and stress-free. Duke is social with other greyhounds and truly stands out for his incredibly calm nature around small dogs, making him a great candidate for homes with smaller canine companions. If you’re looking for a chilled, low-maintenance companion with a sweet and gentle nature, Duke could be your perfect match.

NAME: Cracker
TEXT: Meet Cracker, a handsome 7-year-old greyhound with a big personality and a love for people. Cracker is a confident and cheerful boy who enjoys getting out and about, happily exploring his surroundings with a wagging tail and a bouncy, upbeat attitude. He brings a fun energy to his walks and loves being part of the action. He’s incredibly people-focused and engaging, often approaching for pats and happily sticking around to soak up the attention. Cracker thrives on interaction and would make a wonderful companion for someone who enjoys a social and affectionate dog. Cracker walks well on lead and travels nicely in the car, making him an easy addition to day-to-day life. He’s confident in new environments and takes everything in stride. He gets along well with other big dogs and has previously been around small dogs in a home environment. However, he can become very overexcited, so he would be best suited to a home without small pets where he can remain calm and comfortable. If you’re looking for a confident, affectionate, and fun-loving companion who will keep you company and bring a bit of joy to your day, Cracker could be the perfect match.

NAME: Frankie
TEXT: Meet Frankie, a fun-loving greyhound with a happy personality and a playful spark. Frankie is a confident and easygoing boy who enjoys exploring his surroundings, happily sniffing and taking everything in. While he’s generally calm and relaxed, he also has a playful side and loves the occasional burst of zoomies, adding a bit of joy and energy to his day. He’s a friendly and approachable dog who will come over with a wagging tail to say hello and enjoy a pat. Frankie has a lovely nature and strikes a great balance between being affectionate and independent. On lead, Frankie is confident and responsive, walking nicely without pulling and happy to slip straight into a walk. He travels well and remains calm in the car, making him an easy companion for outings. Frankie gets along well with other greyhounds and shows calm, friendly behaviour around small dogs. If you’re looking for a cheerful, well-mannered companion with a playful streak and a friendly nature, Frankie could be the perfect addition to your home.

NAME: Dave
TEXT: Meet Dave, a handsome greyhound with a confident nature and a friendly, easygoing personality. Dave is a relaxed and happy boy who enjoys getting out and about, exploring his surroundings with a wagging tail and curious nose. He takes new environments in his stride and brings a calm confidence to everything he does. He’s an affectionate companion who will happily come over for pats and enjoys spending time with his people. Dave has a lovely balance of independence and friendliness, making him an easy dog to have around. On lead, Dave is confident and can be strong at times, but he responds well to guidance and settles nicely with consistent handling. He travels well and is relaxed in the car, making him a great companion for outings and adventures. Dave has great social skills and gets along well with other big dogs. He has also lived with small dogs and showed calm, friendly behaviour during assessment, making him a fantastic option for homes with smaller canine companions. If you’re looking for a confident, friendly, and well-rounded companion who will enjoy both exploring the world and relaxing by your side, Dave could be the perfect match.

NAME: Cleo
TEXT: Meet Cleo, a happy personality and a love for exploring the world around her. Cleo is a cheerful and curious girl who enjoys getting out and about, happily sniffing, exploring, and taking everything in with an enthusiastic wagging tail. She has a fun, bouncy energy and brings a sense of joy to her surroundings. On lead, Cleo is a pleasure to walk. She is relaxed, easy to handle, and walks nicely with a loose lead, making daily outings enjoyable and stress-free. She also travels well and remains calm in the car. Cleo is friendly with people and will come over for pats, enjoying attention and companionship. Cleo is ideally suited to a home with similarly sized dogs or as a solo companion. If you’re looking for a happy, active companion who enjoys her walks and brings a bit of bounce and curiosity to your day, Cleo could be the perfect match.

NAME: Holly
TEXT: Meet Holly, a beautiful 3.5-year-old greyhound with a bright, happy personality and a love for life. Holly is a confident and cheerful girl who approaches everything with enthusiasm. She loves to explore her surroundings, happily sniffing and taking it all in, while remaining calm and self-assured in new environments. She is incredibly people-focused and full of joy, when you call her name, she’ll come bounding over with a wagging tail, ready for pats and attention. Her affectionate and playful nature makes her a wonderful companion for someone looking for a loving and interactive dog. Holly walks well on lead with a confident, happy attitude and travels beautifully, even hopping into the car on her own. She’s an easy dog to take along on outings and will happily join in whatever you’re doing. She gets along well with other greyhounds and shows curiosity in small dogs. If you’re looking for a fun, affectionate, and confident companion who will greet you with excitement and brighten your day, Holly could be the perfect match.

NAME: Albert
TEXT: Meet Albert, a gentle and people-loving greyhound who is ready to settle into a relaxed home life. Albert has already had a taste of home living and absolutely thrives in it. He enjoys trips to the beach, loves a splash in the water, and is happiest when he’s close to his people. Affection is his favourite thing, he’ll happily come over for pats, respond to his name, and stay nearby to soak up all the attention he can get. He is a calm and easygoing boy who travels well and walks beautifully on lead without pulling. In new environments, Albert is relaxed and confident, enjoying a quiet explore but always happiest when he can check back in with his humans. Albert gets along well with other greyhounds and shows good general manners. He can be unsure around small dogs, particularly if they enter his personal space. He would be best in a home where he gets to soak up all the attention. If you’re looking for a loyal, affectionate companion who will stick by your side, join you on outings, and happily relax with you at home, Albert could be the perfect match.

NAME: Blondie
TEXT: Meet Blondie, a 6-year-old greyhound with a confident, affectionate, and easygoing personality. Blondie is a friendly and curious girl who loves to explore her surroundings at a relaxed pace. She confidently sniffs and investigates her environment while staying calm and happy, making her a joy to have around. She is affectionate with people, approaching with a wagging tail and happily asking for pats. On lead, Blondie is confident and easy to manage, though she can be strong at times. Blondie has excellent manners with other greyhounds and is friendly toward small dogs. She is ready to find a loving home where she can enjoy companionship, walks, and lots of pats. If you’re looking for a confident, friendly, and affectionate companion who will happily explore with you and enjoys attention, Blondie could be your perfect match.

NAME: Wyatt
TEXT: Meet Wyatt, a 4-year-old greyhound with a calm, affectionate, and easygoing personality. Wyatt is a relaxed and gentle companion who enjoys life at a leisurely pace. He loves to curl up on the couch and snuggle with his people, making him the perfect companion for quiet moments at home. He’s also happy to explore his surroundings at a calm pace, sniffing and taking in the world with curiosity. On lead, Wyatt is a dream, gentle, relaxed, and easy to walk, with no pulling or pressure. He travels well, so outings are always stress-free. Wyatt is a people-lover who will happily come over for pats and enjoys spending time close to his people. He shows a calm and friendly manners with other dogs, including small dogs. If you’re looking for a gentle, affectionate, and calm companion who will happily snuggle on the couch or join you on relaxed adventures, Wyatt could be your perfect match.

NAME: Jack
TEXT: Meet Jack who raced as Sugar Jack, a charming 6-year-old greyhound with a gentle nature and a heart full of affection. Jack is a confident and relaxed boy who takes everything in his stride. Whether he’s out exploring or simply enjoying a stroll, he moves through the world with calm curiosity, happy to sniff, wander, and check in with his people along the way. He’s a lovely companion on lead, walking beautifully with a loose lead and no pulling, making him an easy addition to daily life. Jack also travels in the vehicle well, so he’s ready to join you on all your outings. Jack is a people-lover at heart. He will happily approach and ask for pats and, once he’s getting attention, he’s more than content to stay and soak it all up. His friendly, easygoing personality makes him a joy to spend time with. He shows great manners around other dogs, including small dogs, greeting them with a wagging tail and calm demeanour. Jack does have a little quirk, a half tail, which only adds to his unique charm and character. If you’re looking for a calm, affectionate, and well-mannered companion who will happily share both adventures and quiet moments, Jack could be your perfect match.

NAME: Sean
TEXT: Meet Sean, a handsome 3.5-year-old greyhound with a calm, confident nature and a quietly affectionate personality. Sean is an easygoing boy who enjoys exploring his surroundings at a relaxed pace. He’s confident in new environments and takes everything in stride, happily sniffing and observing the world around him without becoming overwhelmed. While he may not be overly demanding of attention, Sean will happily come up for a pat and enjoys gentle affection. He has a lovely, independent streak balanced with a sweet, approachable nature. On lead, Sean can be a little eager at first, but he settles quickly and walks along nicely once he’s into the rhythm. He travels well and remains calm, making him a good companion for everyday life. Sean is relaxed around both large and small dogs and is happy to quietly go about his own business. If you’re looking for a relaxed, low-maintenance companion with a gentle nature and a quiet confidence, Sean could be the perfect addition to your home.

NAME: Corby
TEXT: Meet Corby, a handsome 5-year-old greyhound with a friendly nature and an easygoing charm. Corby is a relaxed and confident boy who takes life in stride. Whether he’s out exploring or simply enjoying a quiet moment, he approaches everything with calm curiosity, happy to sniff, look around, and take in the world at his own pace. He absolutely loves people and is always ready to greet you with a wagging tail and a friendly demeanour. Corby enjoys affection all over making him a lovely companion both at home and out and about. On lead, Corby is a pleasure to walk. He moves along nicely without pulling, making daily walks enjoyable and stress-free. He also travels well and remains calm, so he’ll fit easily into a variety of lifestyles. Corby is social and well-mannered with other dogs, including small dogs, showing calm and friendly behaviour with gentle interest. If you’re looking for a calm, affectionate, and well-rounded companion who will slot effortlessly into your life, Corby could be the perfect match.

NAME: Johnny
TEXT: This boy is inquisitive and affectionate, great with young kids and social with other hounds. Lives around farm animals and wasn't bothered by the cat living on the property.

NAME: Alpha
TEXT: This stunning lad is great on the lead, good on his own and around kids daily. He has been around farm animals and is very social with the other hounds on the property.

NAME: Ace
TEXT: This pretty boy is confident and inquisitive, he likes playing in the yard and going on walks. He has been with small kids his whole life and is very gentle and obedient with them. He has had exposure to farm animals and some natives.

NAME: Marley
TEXT: This young gent has grown up around farm animals with visits from local natives. Has small children around daily helping with his daily routine. Gorgeous boy.

NAME: Roy
TEXT: Roy is good with other dogs and good around kids. Roy is a shy character that likes to take his time to get use to new things. Roy is a stunning blue boy that would make a great addition to the right home. Roy has had experience living the apartment lifestyle.

NAME: Big Red
TEXT: Big Red is a beautiful well built hound. Despite his size and strapping appearance he is a big softie. He is good with kids and social with other dogs.

NAME: Spida
TEXT: Spida is a stunning athletic boy, he would suit adventure and a place with a yard, he is gentle with kids but keep in mind he is a large boy who loves to play. He is good on the lead and good to be left alone.

NAME: Yazzi
TEXT: This dynamic girl is very social and confident, she has had exposure to farm animals and the odd visit from the local native critters. Since she is so confident and social she would adjust to many different lifestyles.

NAME: Puzzle
TEXT: 🧩 Meet Puzzle – Your Perfect Missing Piece 🧩 Puzzle is a gentle, quiet soul who brings a sense of calm wherever she goes. She’s not one for chaos or constant activity—instead, she’s happiest lounging nearby, whether that’s stretched out in a sunny spot or curled up close while you relax. Puzzle would suit a peaceful home or apartment lifestyle perfectly, especially with someone patient who will give her the time she needs to feel safe. She may be a little shy at first, but once she’s comfortable, her sweet nature truly shines—she’ll lean in for gentle pats and stay by your side, offering a soft, steady kind of companionship. If your life feels like it’s missing something calm, loving, and quietly special, Puzzle might just be the piece that completes it. 🐾💛

NAME: Didee
TEXT: Meet Didee, a beautiful 5-year-old greyhound with a calm, gentle soul and impeccable manners. Didee is the definition of a “lady-like” companion. She is soft-natured, affectionate, and loves nothing more than a quiet pat and some quality time with her people. Her sweet and gentle personality makes her an easy dog to fall in love with. On lead, Didee is a dream to walk, she moves along with a loose lead, never pulling, and is happy to stroll by your side at a relaxed pace. In new environments, she remains calm and composed, enjoying a quiet sniff and explore rather than becoming overexcited. Didee travels well and is comfortable around vehicles, making her an easy addition to everyday life. She also gets along well with other greyhounds and shows excellent manners around small dogs. Her calm and respectful nature suggests she could suit a variety of home environments. If you’re looking for a quiet, affectionate, and beautifully behaved companion who will bring a sense of calm and companionship to your home, Didee could be the perfect match.

NAME: Lucy
TEXT: Meet Lucy, a joyful and affectionate 5-year-old greyhound who is ready to find her forever home. Lucy is full of personality and absolutely adores people. She thrives on human interaction and will happily seek out attention, often greeting you with excited little jumps and a constantly wagging tail. Her enthusiasm for life is contagious, she truly “loves everything” and brings a bright, happy energy wherever she goes. She travels beautifully, showing a relaxed and positive attitude around vehicles, and walks well on lead with manageable excitement. Lucy is confident in new environments and takes everything in stride, making her an easy companion to bring along on daily adventures. Lucy would suit a home where she has plenty of company, as she forms strong bonds with her people and doesn’t enjoy being left alone for long periods. She will thrive in a household that can give her the attention and companionship she craves. While Lucy is friendly with other greyhounds and larger dogs, her excitement can be a bit much for smaller dogs, so she would be best suited to a home without small pets. She’s a loving, lively girl who just needs the right family to share her big heart with. If you’re looking for a happy, people-loving companion who will greet you like you’re the best part of her day, Lucy might be your perfect match.

NAME: Sunny
TEXT: If you're looking for a toy loving, office-snoozing charming companion, meet Sunny who has been keeping us company in the office. Sunny is a wonderfully affectionate greyhound who loves being a member of the GAP office. If you’re looking for a laid back companion who can go with the flow, Sunny is a great fit. Sunny has been spending his days relaxing in the office, where he has proven himself to be a calm and easy indoor companion. For most of the day, he’s content to snooze on his bed, quietly observing the world around him. That said, he lights up when it’s time for fun. Sunny has been social with other greyhounds and dogs, but he is enthusiastic and playful. He can sometimes forget his size when he’s having a good time, so he would be best matched with a tolerant, playful canine companion. He suit full time workers, particularly if he has a consistent routine like our office. Sunny has shown he can settle well indoors, including in office-style environments. Sunny is such a sweetheart here. He will pose for photos, chase toys and listen to all your phone calls happily! Meet Sunny at Western Sydney.

NAME: Tim Tam
TEXT: Whether you're a double coat, caramel or an original Tim Tam fan, we can all agree Tim Tams are a sweet treat and a family favourite. He is the perfect blend of calm natured and sometimes playful, what more could you want in a canine companion. He walks lovely on the lead and would suit a home without exposure to small dogs. Tim Tam gets along with dogs his size. Due to his friendly nature, he will suit a family that have respectful children. Tim Tam comes when called and is polite around new people! Tim Tam is available at Western Sydney.

NAME: Nelly
TEXT: Meet Nelly 💛 Nelly is a gentle, sensitive soul who is just waiting for the right home to help her truly blossom. While she may be a little shy when meeting new people, once she gets to know you she becomes incredibly sweet, affectionate, and loyal. The bond you’ll build with Nelly will be one of those special, heart-melting connections that makes all the patience worthwhile. Nelly is looking for a quiet, calm home where she can settle into pet life at her own pace. Busy households or lots of noise can feel overwhelming for her, so she would thrive in a peaceful environment with patient adopters who understand that confidence takes time to grow. Because of her sensitive nature, Nellys ideal home is with an adult-only household or older children aged 16+ with dog experience. She needs a predictable, calm environment to feel safe and secure. She would also really benefit from having a friendly, confident canine companion. A doggy friend could help show her the ropes, build her confidence, and encourage her to relax. Once she feels safe, Nelly settles beautifully indoors and is a huge fan of the couch ! snuggling up for a cozy evening is one of her favorite things! She’s the perfect companion for someone who enjoys quiet nights in, gentle walks, and sharing their home (and sofa!) with a loving best friend. If you have a calm home, a kind heart, and maybe even a friendly resident dog, Nelly could be the perfect addition to your family

NAME: Anna
TEXT: Meet Anna 💛 Anna is a sweet, gentle young greyhound with a heart of gold. She may be a little shy when you first meet her, but it doesn’t take long for her true personality to shine. Once she feels comfortable, Anna absolutely loves a good pat and will happily greet people on her walks with a wag and a soft, friendly presence. She enjoys the simple things in life - relaxing by your side, heading out for leisurely walks, or having a gentle play in the yard with her favourite ball. Anna has a calm, affectionate nature that makes her a lovely companion in a peaceful home. Anna is wonderful with gentle children aged 6 and up, and she truly thrives being around people. On warmer days, she delights in cooling off with a splash in her shell pool, and she’s even enjoyed swimming in a dam on farm visits. She has spent time alongside a kelpie cross and a mini groodle, as well as calmly ignoring the household cat. Anna would make a wonderful addition to a family or a couple looking for a loyal and loving companion. As she settles into her new home and continues to grow, she would do best with people who have time to spend with her during weekdays, helping her build confidence and feel secure. If you’re looking for a gentle soul to share your days with, Anna might just be your perfect match 🐾

NAME: Indy
TEXT: Indy is a gentle, easy-going greyhound with a soft heart. She’s the kind of dog who slips seamlessly into family life, happy to snooze nearby, join you for a stroll, or simply be part of whatever’s happening at home. Great with other dogs: Indy has a calm, polite nature and gets along beautifully with canine companions. Cat-friendly: Indy is one of those greyhounds who is perfectly content sharing her space with feline housemates. Laid-back personality: She is a relaxed girl who loves a comfy bed, a sunny spot, and quiet companionship. Family-ready: Indy thrives on gentle affection and would be a fantastic addition to a home looking for a sweet, steady companion. Whether she’s curled up on the couch, quietly padding around the house, or trotting alongside you on a walk, Indy brings a peaceful presence wherever she goes.

NAME: Skippy
TEXT: Meet Skippy, the greyhound who never quite figured out he isn’t a kangaroo. With springs for legs and joy in his heart, Skippy bounds everywhere he goes, whether he’s leaping across the yard, bouncing into your arms, or boinging from room to room just to say hello. This super-friendly boy is the embodiment of good vibes. He greets every human like a long‑lost friend, every dog like a potential playmate, and every day like the Best Day Ever. Skippy's tail wags with such enthusiasm it could almost power a small wind farm. Skippy brings sunshine, silliness, and a whole lot of love wherever he goes. If you're lucky enough to share life with him, get ready for bouncy greetings, warm snuggles, and endless joy.

NAME: Betty
TEXT: Betty is the definition of joyful energy wrapped in a long‑legged greyhound. She loves life, people, and pretty much anything that involves attention or adventure. Whether she’s doing zoomies in the yard or gently nudging you for pats, Betty brings sunshine with her everywhere she goes. Betty loves fast sprints followed by epic naps, meeting new humans and dog friends (suitable for other medium to large dogs. Being told she’s a “good girl”… which she absolutely is! Betty has a sweet, affectionate nature that makes her instantly lovable. She’s friendly to the core,happy to greet strangers, soak up affection. Despite her playful bursts of energy, she’s just as skilled at lounging gracefully like a furry throw pillow. Betty suits a home that appreciates both her zoomie sessions and her champion-level napping. She thrives with humans who enjoy affection, laughs, and a dog who ignites joy just by being herself.

NAME: Flash
TEXT: Flash is a confident and affectionate boy. He can operate the stairs, he comes when called upon in a large area. Has had exposure to mixed dog breeds and has been around children. Flash has also had exposure to native animals that live in the area.

NAME: Gus
TEXT: Gus is a special boy who is confident and inquisitive. He comes when called upon, he is extremely friendly. Gus can do stairs and has had some inside experience. He is a beautiful boy who would make a fantastic family member.

NAME: Bart
TEXT: Bart is a handsome confident boy who prefers being a lone ranger. He is confident and happy on his own and not big on sharing his space with other animals. He is loyal and would make a perfect companion for someone who needs a low maintenance mate to keep them company at home.

NAME: Betty
TEXT: Beautiful Betty is the sister of Poppy who is also searching for a forever home. They are very similar, both petite and smaller in size. Betty loves a run in the yard and exploring, she does come when called upon, she can do stairs and she gets along with everyone she meets. She has had exposure to a diverse mix of domestic and native animals.

NAME: Poppy
TEXT: Poppy is a beautiful vibrant girl, she is still very young and was destined for pet life given her free spirit personality and playful behavior. She gets along with everyone she meets and has exposure to the local native animals on her south coast property.

NAME: Opal (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Opal's foster care update: "Opal is suitable for full time workers, as he can settle indoors for 8 hours with no toilet accidents. He is indoors when his family go to work. and has shown to settle and has learnt perfect toilet training, making him a great fit for an apartment living family/couple. He just asks for a couch and a person to love him. He can hold all day, is never destructive, and loves to watch the world go by through the window." "Opal has been the goodest boy. He is sweet, loving, well behaved & incredibly funny. We have been leaving him at home from 8am till midday (I go home to check on him in my lunch break) then he's alone again from 12:45pm - 3:45pm & he has not had a single accident inside. He absolutely adores our 21 year old son (& our son adores him) & will go & sit with him in his room every chance he gets." --------- Opal is a very friendly and affectionate boy, and loves just loves everyone he meets! His outgoing personality has made him a fan favourite here at GAP HQ. Opal would love a backyard to call his own. Respectful children are suitable, however Opal would prefer to be the only pet in the household so he can soak up all the love and attention for himself. In foster he is learning to be left alone as his foster carers work full time and are building him up to spend hours alone. So come on down down and excavate this precious and valuable Opal today! Submit an application to take him home. He is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Ricky
TEXT: Ricky is a calm, affectionate greyhound who is still learning the ropes of pet life and taking it all in stride. He has a gentle, easygoing presence and enjoys being close to his people, especially when affection and praise are involved. He’s the kind of dog who thrives on positive attention and is keen to please once he understands what’s being asked of him. Ricky is currently building his basic life skills and responding well to training, particularly when it’s delivered with encouragement, praise, and calm guidance. As his confidence and understanding grow, so does his ability to settle, making him a good candidate for a home with full-time workers once he’s had time to adjust and learn how to relax independently. He would benefit from a home with access to a backyard, where he can move freely, decompress, and enjoy some quiet outdoor time. While Ricky may enjoy the company of another greyhound or a medium to large dog, he can be a little socially awkward when initiating play. Because of this, any canine companion should be tolerant, steady, and happy to set gentle boundaries. Ricky is looking for a home that understands he’s still learning and is happy to guide him through this next chapter with patience and kindness. With the right support, he has all the makings of a relaxed, affectionate companion who will settle beautifully into family life and enjoy the simple pleasures of being a pet.

NAME: Bridget
TEXT: *Bridget has spent time in foster care - update below!* Hey guys! In my first week in foster, I have now mastered the stairs and am enjoying the yummy treats and extra cuddles. I enjoy exploring the house and watching my new human friends go about their daily lives. I get excited for my dinner and do a little prance which has delighted my new friends. I have made myself comfortable on the lounges and I have been enjoying some alone time already being solo for three hours just relaxing on the sofa on the deck. Bridget is a sweet girl who steals your heart after opening up. She would suit a quiet household without children or a busy social lifestyle. Bridget is very much a homebody who enjoys lounging and taking life at a slower pace. While she may be able to live with a medium to large dog, any companion would need to be particularly tolerant and socially steady, as Bridget can become a little socially clumsy when she’s feeling playful or unsure. Even so, her greatest comfort comes from her relationship with her people. Neck scratches are her love language and once you win her over and she'll be endlessly entertaining you with her playful antics. As you inevitably fall in love with one another, her gentle demeaner will give way to a more quirky side. Pairing that iconic greyhound charm with her own unique twist. Solidified in your bond, she will lean on your confidence in her to navigate the unfamiliar world. A home that is willing to support her as she adjusts to her new lifestyle is ideal. New friends are on the horizon of your patience and compassion, revealing to her joy in previous uncertainties. A journey you and her will never forget.

NAME: Louie
TEXT: Louie is a gentle, quiet soul. If you're looking for a laid back senior greyhound, Louie might be perfect for you. Louie is a lovely greyhound who loves mingling with other dogs his size, settles well alone and would love a home with indoor outdoor access where he can independently alternate between exploring outside and resting on beds indoors. He is suitable with older/respectful kids and dreams of a backyard to snooze in. He would like a flat home without stairs, as he is still learning how to navigate staircases. Louie is a sweet gentleman and he hopes you come to meet him soon. Meet Louie at Western Sydney.

NAME: Ally
TEXT: I am a gorgeous girl on medical recovery, looking for a home where someone is home most of the time, eg retired/work from home. Either someone home or a companion grey to settle me in would be great. I have a big, loving personality, and can be goofy as I am still young at heart, but it's best I take it easy. I need a small yard/courtyard, and can suit teenage kids with dog experience. I'm social with Medium-Large dogs and would LOVE a dog friend! But it's best I don't zoom around a lot, so an older, laid back dog friend would be best. I love having play in a small space/indoors. Enquire with the Western Sydney team to meet me.

NAME: Chunk
TEXT: Meet Chunk – The Quiche-Connoisseur 🐶 Chunk is a friendly, easy-going boy with a heart of gold and a nose for snacks! He’s a social boy who loves the company of other dogs and would be more than happy to share his space (and his toys) with a furry friend. Don’t let his name fool you – Chunk is all charm and cheer. He may take a little time to say hello properly, but once he’s settled, he’s all smiles and tail wags. His gentle nature makes him a lovely companion, and he’s always up for a cuddle or a game. Be warned: Chunk is a bit of a food enthusiast. He may sneak a bite of your quiche if you’re not looking – but he promises to do it with love. 😄 If you’re after a laid-back, affectionate pup with a bit of a cheeky side, Chunk might just be your perfect match.

NAME: Jessie
TEXT: PUPPY ALERT! Jessie is a 10 month old brindle female looking for a home. Jessie is a vibrant, bouncy, fun loving girl. Jessie would best suit a family experienced with all things puppy. Her ideal home is a home who would encourage her to be the best puppy she can be with regular training, enrichment and exposure to the big wide world, other dogs, and all things pet life. She is looking for a house with a fully fenced backyard and a fun filled life. She would suit a family with respectful kids. She is confident and she likes being part of the action, whether it’s playtime, zoomies, toys, treats, and all things exciting - she's all about it! Shorter/less hours alone would suit her best as she learns to be a pet. If she is to live with another dog, one who has experience with high energy/puppies would be best suited. As a young pup, she’s still learning the ropes and will thrive in a home ready to guide her with patience, love, and structure. Meet Jessie at Western Sydney by appointment.

NAME: Wally
TEXT: Wally is a handsome 5-year-old boy who is ready to enjoy a relaxed home life. He’s a friendly, easygoing boy who loves meeting people. While he can be a little shy at first, he warms up quickly and shows his affectionate nature. He is calm in new environments and enjoys a gentle explore before settling in, making him well suited to a house or townhouse. Wally has been around children and has a gentle, relaxed temperament, making him a great family companion. He has gets excited with playful but polite behaviour to meet dogs of all sizes however settles settles quickly. Wally also travels well in the car, happily lying down for the ride, though he may need a lift to get in.

NAME: Missy (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Missy is an adorable sweet little girl with a little white tip on her tail and super cute white socks. She has a cute personality to match. She is polite around dogs big and small, and would suit a home with another dog. She keeps a slow pace on the leash with a more shy than outgoing nature overall. She gains confidence around other dogs so a home who can keep up dog socialisation would be a great fit. A home without children would be best as she can be alert to sights and sounds, and a family with kids might prove overwhelming. She is a sweet little girl who would love to find a family to call her own. Meet Missy at Western Sydney!

NAME: Sandra
TEXT: If you're looking for a sweet girl who can grow confidence around you in slow, steady steps, meet Sandra. Sandra is a shy natured, subdued girl who is looking for a calm and nurturing home. A quiet neighbourhood and a low key, understanding and low stress lifestyle is best suited for her. She requires a backyard/townhouse yard to retreat to when things get overwhelming, but we have seen she can bond well with people once she gets to know them and warms up nicely. If you want to see your love and loyalty benefit a shy dog like Sandra, get in touch with Western Sydney.

NAME: Jasmine
TEXT: Jasmine is a shy girl at first, but given some time to bond with her new family, she will bloom into a loving companion. Jasmine will enjoy snoozing in a quiet neighbourhood if you have a backyard of any size. She would suit a home without other dogs her size, and could be suited to living with teenage children who are greyhound experienced, provided they are respectful of her space and appreciate her need for calmness and quiet, nurturing love. A home experienced with shy dogs is a must as we want to see Jasmine blossom into the best version of herself. If you are a calm, understanding family with lots of love to give, come and meet Jasmine today at the Western Sydney Adoption Centre.

NAME: Ringo
TEXT: Ringo has the sweetest little face you ever have seen! He can be shy when he's first getting to know you, and would love a nurturing home to continue to grow his confidence. He has experience mingling with a staffy and would thrive in a multi-dog household. Older/teenage kids on the quiet/calm side would be best suited to Ringo while he grows in confidence. He loves praise and being spoken to in a calm way, and has shown he is a great listener to cues. Ringo dreams of a backyard with opaque fencing so he can enjoy the serenity of his down time. Meet cutie pie Ringo at Western Sydney!

NAME: Freddie
TEXT: Freddie is a clean handsome hound that would make a great addition to any family. He is great company, great on the lead and doesn't lack confidence. Freddie would make a great companion.

NAME: Sasha
TEXT: This beautiful black and white girl is gentle and very clean in her space. She would suit many different settings given her confident yet laid back personality. She relaxes well on her own and is social with other animals.

NAME: Frankie
TEXT: This petite female is lovely to be around. She is a very quiet and clean girl. She is confident and affectionate and she gets along with everyone. She has had kids in her life along with other dog breeds, domestic livestock and visits from local deer.

NAME: Max
TEXT: Meet Max 🐾 Max is an energetic, fun-loving boy who’s always ready for action! He absolutely loves playtime and will happily keep himself (and you!) entertained with his toys and zoomies. Full of life and personality, Max brings a playful spark to every moment, but he also has a sweet, affectionate side and enjoys spending time with his humans. Max is the perfect mix of outgoing and loving. If you’re looking for a happycompanion who will keep you smiling, Max is your guy!

NAME: Jett
TEXT: Meet Jett 🖤 Jett is a confident, fun-loving boy with a big personality and an even bigger heart. He absolutely adores being around his humans and will happily follow you wherever you go, just to be part of the action. This cheeky boy loves his toys and is always up for a play, bringing a playful and energetic vibe into the home. Jett’s loving nature makes him a wonderful companion, whether it’s playtime or just relaxing by your side. If you’re looking for a loyal, affectionate, and entertaining best mate, Jett is your guy!

NAME: Pizza
TEXT: Pizza is a confident, happy-go-lucky boy with a big personality and an even bigger heart. He’s fantastic with all dogs and currently lives comfortably alongside other greyhounds, making him a great choice for a home with existing canine companions. Playful and full of life, Pizza loves to have fun and enjoys his adventures—especially when they involve travelling and exploring new places. Whether it’s a car ride, a day out, or just playtime at home, he’s always ready to be part of the action. When Pizza isn’t busy playing, he’s busy loving. He’s incredibly affectionate and well known for standing right over you, politely (or not so politely!) demanding cuddles and attention. Personal space isn’t really his thing—he’d much rather be close to his people. If you’re looking for a confident, social, and loving greyhound who will keep you smiling and ensure you never miss out on a cuddle, Pizza might just be your perfect match. 💙🐾

NAME: Sky
TEXT: This petite girl is very pretty and lovely company. She is very calm and quiet, makes no mess and is very clean. She loves being around and is happy to take it easy.

NAME: Bella
TEXT: Bella is a beautiful dynamic hound, she is confident and playful. She comes when called and loves affection.

NAME: Reggie
TEXT: This handsome fella lives on the south coast in a residential area. He is great walking on the lead and getting around the community. He gets on well with dogs of all sizes and loves all size people he meets. he is an extroverted confident boy who is great company.

NAME: Rusty
TEXT: Rusty is a quirky young hound. He is a little quiet and nervous at first and may need to warm up a little. He is a handsome affectionate boy with lots of love to give. Given an opportunity he will soon become a loving, affectionate family member.

NAME: Hank
TEXT: Hank is a bold and spirited boy who brings a fun, lively energy wherever he goes. Full of personality, he loves to stretch his legs and show off his playful side with a good burst of zoomies. He’s a strong, active boy who will thrive in a home that enjoys getting out and about. Hank would suit someone who can match his enthusiasm. Behind his energetic nature is a sweet, loyal companion who enjoys being around his people and settling in once he’s had his fun. With the right home, Hank will be a rewarding and entertaining addition to the family 🐾

NAME: Phoenix
TEXT: Phoenix 🐾 Meet Phoenix, a confident and fun-loving boy with a big personality to match! This clever lad comes straight over when called, always eager to be part of the action. He absolutely loves his toys and brings a playful, energetic vibe wherever he goes. Phoenix is full of life but equally full of love - he thrives on attention and will happily soak up pats and affection from his people. With his bright nature and loyal heart, Phoenix would make a wonderful companion for someone looking for a happy, active, and devoted best mate.

NAME: Friend
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Friend – the Gentle, Easy‑Going Soul If you’re looking for a calm, sweet-natured companion to slot effortlessly into family life, Friend might just be your perfect match. This handsome male greyhound truly lives up to his name—he’s gentle, placid, and simply loves being by your side. 🌊 Beach-Loving Boy Friend’s happy place is the beach. Whether it’s strolling along the shoreline or quietly watching the waves, he’s in his element. He’s not the racing-around type—just content to enjoy the fresh air and take things at his own relaxed pace. 💤 Low-Energy & Laid-Back If you’re imagining a couch buddy who’s just as happy to nap as he is to join you for a leisurely walk, Friend is your guy. He’s not overly energetic and is perfectly suited to a quieter lifestyle. 👨‍👩‍👧 Great with Kids Friend is wonderfully tolerant and patient with children aged four and up, who are respectful and polite. His calm nature and soft approach make him a lovely fit for a family looking for an easy-going canine companion. ❤️ Why You’ll Fall in Love Placid and affectionate Easy to handle and easy to live with Loves gentle outings like beach trips Friend is ready to bring warmth, companionship, and a steady presence into his new home. If you’re after a loyal boy with a soft heart and an even softer stride through life, Friend is waiting to meet you.

NAME: Indiana
TEXT: Meet Indiana Indiana is a sweet and affectionate girl who forms strong bonds with her people. She loves being involved in whatever you’re doing, whether that’s relaxing at home or enjoying a bit of outdoor fun. Indiana has a happy, playful nature and brings a lovely energy to her surroundings. She gets along well with other greyhounds and is comfortable sharing her space, making her an easy companion in a multi‑dog home. On warm days, Indiana’s favourite place is the pool—she’s always ready for a splash or a cool dip to beat the heat. When it comes to small dogs, she can get a little excited at first, but with a calm handler and a moment to settle, she quickly relaxes and focuses again. She shows every sign of being a girl who simply needs a bit of guidance and consistency. Indiana is looking for a home that will enjoy her gentle affection, playful moments, and loyal companionship.

NAME: Buster
TEXT: Meet Buster Buster is a fun, beach‑loving male Greyhound who’s happiest with sand under his feet and waves splashing around him. He loves the beach, enjoys swimming in the surf, and never says no to chasing a ball along the shoreline. He’s a very friendly boy with a cheerful nature and makes an excellent housemate—clean, well‑mannered, and easy to have around. Buster has no concept of personal space and loves to check out what is going on. Buster has met small dogs and is polite, but he can be quite exuberant and playful, so he’s best suited to a home with medium to large breed dogs who can match his energy.
