Buster has met children and would make a great companion for polite dog savvy children who want to play with him, but remember he is active. If you’re looking for an affectionate, active companion who will happily join you on seaside adventures, Buster might be your perfect match.

NAME: Tilly
TEXT: Meet Tilly Tilly is an easygoing, relaxed girl who takes new environments in her stride. She travels well in both the car walks nicely on lead, settling quickly and showing good manners. She has a naturally chilled, social temperament—happy to explore, have a sniff, and calmly spend time with other dogs. Tilly is very friendly with people, coming over for pats when called and showing a lovely, gentle interest. Tilly mixes well with dogs of all sizes. She was polite and appropriate with small dogs and interacted comfortably with the larger dogs she met, showing confident yet relaxed social skills. One thing to note: Tilly does not like sharing her food, so mealtimes are best managed separately from other dogs. Overall, Tilly is a swee, and well‑mannered girl who would make a wonderful companion for someone seeking a friendly, relaxed Greyhound who blends easily into day‑to‑day life.

NAME: Hope
TEXT: Meet Hope Hope is a sweet, friendly girl with a calm and happy nature. She has been crate trained, walks well on lead, and is good with small dogs. Hope has lived in a home environment and is a very clean and tidy housemate. She copes confidently in busy environments, taking everything in her stride, and settles easily once things quiet down. Hope would make a wonderful companion for someone looking for comfort, company, and a gentle, easygoing dog to share their days with.

NAME: Turbo
TEXT: Turbo is an active, outgoing Greyhound with a friendly and confident personality. He enjoys playtime and getting involved in what’s happening around him, but once he’s had his fun, he settles well and is quiet and easy to have around. He’s very people‑oriented and would suit a home with children aged 10 and over who can enjoy his playful side while giving him space when he’s resting. Tueb’s mix of energy, friendliness, and calm downtime makes him a great fit for families or individuals looking for a sociable but well‑mannered companion.

NAME: Pete
TEXT: Meet Pete 🐾 Pete is an easy-going, happy and calm boy who has settled beautifully into home life. He’s been living indoors with other Greyhounds, a Pointer and a Staffy, and gets along well with them all, making him a very relaxed housemate. Pete loves a car ride and is a pleasure to walk on lead. He’s not reactive to passing people, children or other dogs, and takes everything in stride. Large, busy crowds like those around shopping centres can make him a little hesitant at first, but overall he handles the world calmly and politely. At home, Pete is a classic Greyhound - happiest when he’s relaxing on his bed. When he’s not enjoying a snooze, you might find him chasing a ball or toy and even taking it outside himself for a little playtime. Otherwise, he’s content to rest nearby or quietly check in to see what you’re up to. At night, Pete sleeps on his bed beside yours - though if there’s space, he might even squeeze himself under the bed for a cozy hideaway! Pete would make a lovely companion in a multi-dog household or with someone who is home more often than not. He truly enjoys being around his people and is an easy-care, affectionate boy who will happily keep you company through the day. If you’re looking for a gentle, relaxed friend to share your home and your heart, Pete could be the perfect match. 💙🐕

NAME: Gemma
TEXT: Meet Gemma Gemma is a sweet little girl with a beautiful nature and a cheeky personality to match. This lovely lady has a gentle heart but also a playful, fun side that will keep you smiling. Gemma loves attention and enjoys being around people, always happy to share her sweet nature with those around her. With her gorgeous looks and lovable personality, Gemma is sure to steal hearts wherever she goes. She would make a wonderful companion for someone looking for a beautiful girl with a mix of sweetness and cheeky charm. 🐾

NAME: Chester
TEXT: Meet Chester a sweet and gentle boy who is looking for a loving home where he can truly shine. Chester has a calm and affectionate nature and enjoys being close to his people. He’s the kind of companion who will happily sit by your side, enjoying quiet moments and soaking up all the attention you can give. With his kind personality and loving heart, Chester would make a wonderful companion for someone looking for a loyal friend to share their days with. All he needs is a caring home where he can feel safe, loved, and part of the family.

NAME: Jax
TEXT: Meet Jax, a calm and sweet-natured boy who will quickly win you over with his gentle personality. Jax is a friendly companion who enjoys being around people and thrives on affection and attention. He loves the company of other dogs and would happily share his home with a canine friend. With the right, slow introduction, Jax could also potentially be cat workable, making him a great option for a variety of homes. With his easygoing temperament and loving nature, Jax is the kind of loyal companion who will happily be by your side for walks, relaxing days, and plenty of pats. Anyone looking for a friendly and affectionate greyhound will find a wonderful mate in Jax.

NAME: Jay
TEXT: Meet Jay, a fun-loving boy with a beautiful nature and plenty of energy for life. This happy boy has an enthusiastic personality and loves getting out for walks, stretching his legs, and enjoying the world around him. Jay has a bright, friendly spirit that makes him a joy to be around. Jay would also make a great mate for other dogs and enjoys canine company, making him a lovely addition to a home that already has a dog friend. Despite his playful side, he also has a gentle temperament and loves attention and affection from his people. With his sweet personality and lively charm, Jay will make a wonderful companion for someone looking for a loyal, fun, and loving greyhound to share their days with.

NAME: Jeanie
TEXT: Jeanie – 4 years old Meet the beautiful Jeanie. With her calm, old-soul nature, she’s the kind of girl who instantly brings a peaceful presence wherever she goes. Jeanie has the cutest facial features; including markings that look just like little eyebrows - giving her the sweetest expressions that are sure to steal your heart. Easy-going and wonderfully chill, Jeanie enjoys a relaxed stroll and is happiest simply spending time by your side. If you’re looking for a gentle, affectionate companion, Jeanie could be the perfect addition to your home. 💛

NAME: Annie
TEXT: Meet Annie, the 3 year old sweet heart. With her friendly nature and gentle personality, she’s an absolute delight to be around. Annie walks beautifully on lead, happily strolling right beside you and taking everything in her stride. She absolutely loves a pat and will gladly lean in for some extra affection. With her calm, sweet nature and easygoing personality, Annie would make a wonderful companion for someone looking for a gentle, loving greyhound to share their days with. This gorgeous girl is ready to find a forever home where she can enjoy plenty of walks, pats, and love.

NAME: Missy
TEXT: Missy is a very happy and affectionate girl who absolutely loves attention from her people. She has a sweet, friendly nature and is always excited to spend time with those around her. Missy enjoys playing and having a good run around, especially when it’s time for her zoomies. She has a fun, energetic personality that brings lots of joy and laughter. Because Missy can get a little excited and may jump up when greeting people, she would be best suited to a home with older children who can handle her enthusiastic welcomes. With plenty of love, playtime, and guidance, Missy will make a wonderful and devoted companion.

NAME: Jess
TEXT: Jess is a lively and affectionate dog who loves getting out and about. She’s great on the lead and enjoys exploring with her people. Jess has a playful personality and absolutely loves to run around and have her zoomies when the mood strikes. She can be a little skittish around new or loud noises, so she would do best with a patient and experienced owner who can help her build confidence and feel secure. Jess has had good socialisation with a cattle dog and enjoys canine company when introductions are done properly. With the right home, guidance, and plenty of love, Jess will make a loyal and entertaining companion.

NAME: Rusty
TEXT: Meet Rusty 🐾 Rusty is a happy, friendly boy who simply loves being around his people. With his calm, easygoing nature, he’s the kind of dog who enjoys hanging out nearby, soaking up attention, pats, and companionship. Rusty enjoys a run around the backyard (lasting around 5 minutes in true greyhound style), a game with his toys, or heading out for a relaxed afternoon walk where he can take his time sniffing the world around him and greeting people. He's always up for a pat. Rusty is housetrained and currently lives happily alongside a pet dachshund, sleeping and playing well with his little canine friend, also visiting grandkids 6+, and not fussed about budgies flying around. He would make a wonderful family pet or companion for someone looking for a gentle, affectionate dog who enjoys a bit of playtime as well as relaxing by your side. 💛

NAME: Muza
TEXT: Maza is a sweet and gentle girl . She can be a little shy at first and prefers to stick close to her favourite humans, but once she feels comfortable, her affectionate and playful side shines through. She gets along well with other dogs, both small and large, and enjoys joining in on gentle play. Maza travels well in the car and is very food-motivated, which makes training and bonding with her easy. Once she opens up, she’s full of fun and love, making her a loyal and delightful companion.

NAME: Dolly
TEXT: Meet Dolly! Dolly is a calm, confident, and happy greyhound who loves exploring and spending time with people. She is gentle, friendly, and extremely affectionate, enjoying pats and attention from anyone she meets. Dolly loves to travel in the car, settles easily in new places, and is clean in her kennel. She is great with children, polite around small dogs, and super excited to meet other greyhounds. If they are playing then she wants to join in too! Dolly enjoys a sunny snooze spot, adventure walks and most of all time with her humans.

NAME: Nobby
TEXT: Hi, I'm Nobby! I am a sleek, handsome black greyhound who walks perfectly on the lead, you could think of me as your quintessential calm, and engaging greyhound. I am playful, and considered with my greetings. I am friendly with other greyhounds and could live along side another dog big or medium size pending polite introductions at the GAP centre. I have a confident nature, like chasing toys and enjoy a pat. Overall I carry myself with a gentle undersanding nature so a home with respectful kids who are calm and quiet like me would be great. A backyard or courtyard to call my own would be great too! Meet me at Western Sydney.

NAME: Timmy
TEXT: Timmy is a handsome, charismatic blue brindle guy! He is friendly, playful, outgoing and loves his toys. He is confident around unfamiliar people around GAP HQ & shows off his confident side on walkies. He would be suitable to live with older/experienced kids, as Timmy can get excited and forget his size in the heat of the moment. He can live with another dog his size however he doesn't need the companionship. Timmy has shown he can settle well indoors and out, preferring to settle indoors. He could suit full time workers with a structured routine and as he loves being inside, we think an apartment would be suitable. He can even do stairs! Meet Timmy at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Ace (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Hi, I'm Ace! I walk nicely on the lead and warm up after I get to know you. I like toys, and am described as friendly and calm. I would be happy to live with another dog after a meet and greet with them. As I can be shy, a dog who can help me come out of my shell could be a good match for me! As I have not experienced much of pet life yet, a home willing to take it nice and slow with me is best suited. A home with older/respectful kids would suit me best, as well as a house with a backyard for me to spend time in. Meet me at Western Sydney.

NAME: Thunder
TEXT: Thunder is a playful, funny, confident and friendly boy. He has an upbeat personality, and would love a home with toys, fun, and adventures! In his preperation to become a pet, he has learnt crate training, swimming in pools and dams, seen things like mowers, vehicles, and has been around kids 2-6 years old. He can be eager to get going on walks so a family who can walk a stronger dog is best suited. He could live with another doggie his size, however not a requirement. He is bouncy, friendly, and fun loving. A home with a backyard and shorter hours alone when he first settles in would be a great fit for Thunder. Meet Thunder at Western Sydney!

NAME: Jasper
TEXT: Hi, I'm Jasper! I'm a gorgeous fawn boy, I'm confident, happy and easy to make friends with. He would best suit a female canine companion if he's to go home with another dog. He is a lovely walker on the lead showing off his confidence and would enjoy daily walkies. He has been described as energetic, outgoing and friendly. He would love a backyard to do zoomies, and a fun active home to keep him entertained. Although he hasn't had experience with children, he is friendly and bubbly and gentle with people and could suit respectful/older kids. Meet Jasper at Western Sydney!

NAME: Patchy
TEXT: Hi, I’m Patchy — a young, gentle boy looking for a calm, nurturing home. I’d love a backyard where I can relax and have some quiet time, in a peaceful neighbourhood with a family who understands that I may take a little time to settle in. I’m naturally quiet and curious, and once I feel safe my sweet personality begins to shine. Because I’m a sensitive soul, a home without children or lots of hustle and bustle would suit me best. Meet me by appointment in Western Sydney. 🐾

NAME: Georgia
TEXT: Georgia is a timid girl who will need a patient and understanding home to help her feel safe and settled. She can be quite reserved at first, so she will benefit from adopters who have experience and are willing to give her the time and gentle guidance she needs to build confidence at her own pace. Georgia is happy to quietly observe the world around her and tends to be quite independent, preferring to take things in from a comfortable distance while she learns to trust her surroundings. She has shown that she can do well with medium sized dogs and may appreciate a calm canine companion. With plenty of patience, consistency, and a supportive environment, Georgia has the potential to slowly come out of her shell and feel secure in her new home. 🐾

NAME: Nickie
TEXT: Nickie can be a little shy when meeting new people, but with a calm environment and a little patience she begins to settle and show her gentle nature. Once she feels comfortable, she enjoys engaging with people and happily accepts pats when she seeks them out. She travels well and has been relaxed when riding in both the car and van, making her a pleasant companion for outings. Nickie has also shown that she can do well around smaller sized dogs. With a quiet home and people who are happy to give her the time she needs to feel safe, Nickie will blossom into a sweet and affectionate companion. 🐾💛

NAME: Danny
TEXT: Danny is a lovely, placid boy who enjoys spending time with his people and soaking up plenty of pats. He has a gentle nature and really values human companionship, happily engaging with those around him. On walks, Danny can initially be a little strong on the lead, but with some extra support and ongoing training he settles well and becomes much easier to handle. He has previously had experience around smaller dogs; however, any future introductions should be done slowly to ensure everyone feels comfortable and safe. Overall, Danny is a sweet, affectionate companion who will thrive in a home that can provide him with guidance, patience, and plenty of love.

NAME: Harvey
TEXT: Meet Harvey 🐾 Harvey is a confident 3-year-old greyhound with a big personality and plenty of zest for life. This happy-go-lucky boy loves to play and enjoys getting out and about, making him a great match for a family with an active lifestyle. Harvey has a playful spirit and brings lots of fun wherever he goes, but he’s also a very sweet boy who enjoys attention and spending time with his people. With his cheerful nature and love for life, Harvey will make a wonderful companion for a family looking for a lively, affectionate greyhound to share their adventures with.

NAME: Raven
TEXT: Meet Raven 🖤 Raven is a sweet and quiet 2-year-old greyhound with a small, delicate frame and a gentle nature. She is lovely to handle and walks beautifully on the lead, making her a calm and easy companion for relaxed strolls. Raven can be a little shy when meeting new people, but with time, patience and plenty of love, her sweet personality begins to shine through. She is a gentle soul who simply needs a family willing to let her settle in at her own pace. With a caring home Raven will blossom into a loyal and affectionate companion and would make a truly lovely addition to a family looking for a an easy going kind-hearted girl.

NAME: Ruthie
TEXT: Meet Sweet Ruthie 🐾 Ruthie is a beautiful 3-year-old greyhound who is gentle and has a petite little frame. She has a calm, sweet nature and carries herself with quiet grace. Ruthie has been wonderful around small dogs, showing respectful and polite manners, and she takes everything in her stride with her soft, easygoing temperament. She would make a truly lovely addition to a family looking for a gentle, affectionate companion. With her sweet personality and kind heart, Ruthie is ready to settle into home life and share all the love she has to give. If you're searching for a calm, cuddly best friend with the sweetest soul, Ruthie might just be your girl!

NAME: Obi Wan Kenobi
TEXT: This is Obi-Wan Kenobi — a brave Jedi knight using the Force to steal hearts across the adoption centre. Obi-Wan Kenobi loves his walkies and might even do a little happy dance when he sees his lead! Loves an adventure, making him a great fit for an active family who enjoy long walks through the galaxy. He is perfectly behaved indoors at the adoption centre. Gentle, affectionate, and loves chilling out, Obi has the quintessential greyhound personality — laid back with moments of playfulness. Obi-Wan Kenobi seeks a family who will respect his Jedi calmness but also embrace his playful side. He’s suited for homes with a peaceful vibe and a little space to run around. Apply for our special boy Obi — and may the peace, paws, and happiness be with you! 🌟🐾

NAME: Ferrari
TEXT: Don’t let her name fool you - Ferrari is a gentle, quiet girl with a soft and reserved nature. She may take a little time to come out of her shell, but with patience and love, her sweet personality truly begins to shine. Ferrari has a stunning black and white coat that makes her just as beautiful on the outside as she is on the inside. She would suit a calm home where she can settle at her own pace and build confidence in a safe, loving environment. With the right home Ferrari will be a loyal and affectionate companion who will quietly steal your heart 🐾

NAME: Rocky
TEXT: Rocky is a gentle, affectionate greyhound with a heart as big as his soulful eyes. This lovely boy thrives on human company and is searching for a home where he can be the centre of someone’s world. Rocky is a naturally sweet, loving, and people focused dog. He adores cuddles, leans, and quiet moments with his favourite humans. He’s the kind of boy who bonds deeply and shows endless loyalty once he feels safe and loved. While Rocky is a total sweetheart with people, he’s at his happiest in a home where he can be the only pet. He loves having his own space and his own humans all to himself—he truly shines when he’s the solo star of the household.

NAME: Chicken
TEXT: Chicken is a joyful, fun loving greyhound. This beautiful girl is bouncy, affectionate, and full of gentle enthusiasm, bringing a spark of happiness wherever she goes. Chicken is a naturally social girl who is sweet‑natured, friendly, and always ready for a snuggle. Whether she’s doing her signature happy prance or leaning in for pats, she’s the kind of dog who makes people smile without even trying. Chicken is wonderfully good with other dogs and children. Her playful yet gentle temperament makes her a great fit for families or homes with other canine companions. Chicken does have missing teeth, so she thrives on a special, softer diet that keeps her comfortable at mealtimes. She doesn’t let it slow her down and is still just as vibrant and cheerful as ever!

NAME: Zues
TEXT: Meet Zeus A handsome boy with a charming short tail and a confident outlook on life, Zeus is a curious and capable greyhound who enjoys exploring his surroundings and taking in the world around him. Zeus is confident and inquisitive on walks. He travels well in the car and handles new environments with ease. While he enjoys a pat, food is definitely the way to his heart! He’s very food motivated, which will make ongoing training both rewarding and fun. Like many bright young hounds, he can become distracted by interesting sights and smells, so he’ll benefit from continued engagement and positive reinforcement to help him stay focused. Zeus has been well behaved around other greyhounds and has previously been kennelled with his sister. However, he can be selective with his canine company and would be best suited as the only dog in the home, where he can soak up all the attention. He would thrive with an owner who can provide structure, enrichment and regular adventures while continuing to build his skills. If you’re looking for a confident, clever and engaging companion to share your days with, Zeus could be the perfect fit.

NAME: Jasper (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Jasper is your quintessential low maintenance kinda guy, playful, but shy, and can take time to warm up. An owner who enjoys helping a shy greyhound come out of their shell is the best fit for Jasper. He likes slow adventures, where he can take things in at his own pace. He likes his quiet time and down time, and enjoys settling down when things are chill, and will go to his crate when he wants some time out. A house with a yard, in a quiet part of town, with a low dog population when out and about would suit Jasper perfectly as he can become overwhelmed with too much happening out and about. He loves all things food and puzzle enrichment, so a home that will provide ongoing mental stimulation in lieu of walkies and adventures will be Jaspers best match. Jasper is polite with other dogs his size at the adoption centre, and could live with one, however not a requirement. Meet Jasper at Western Sydney.

NAME: Evie
TEXT: Meet Evie 💗 Evie is a sweet and friendly girl with a warm, engaging personality. She loves being around her people and naturally seeks connection, making her a wonderful companion for a family who enjoys having their dog close by. Evie would particularly suit a work-from-home household where she can enjoy plenty of company and be part of the daily routine. She thrives on interaction and will happily soak up attention, pats, and time spent together. When first settling into a new home, Evie may need a little patience and reassurance as she adjusts to her new surroundings. With understanding and consistency, she will quickly grow in confidence and show just how loving and loyal she truly is. If you’re looking for an affectionate, people-oriented girl who will blossom with a little patience and a lot of love, Evie could be the perfect addition to your family. 🐾💕

NAME: Storm
TEXT: Meet Storm 🌩️ Storm is a very friendly boy with a confident and curious nature. He loves being involved in whatever is going on and is always keen to explore his surroundings. He’s highly treat motivated, which makes him a joy to engage with and a great candidate for ongoing training. Storm absolutely loves playing fetch and will happily chase after a ball again and again — it’s one of his favourite ways to bond and burn off energy. On lead, Storm can be a little excited initially as he takes in the world around him, but with consistency and guidance, he settles and enjoys the adventure.

NAME: Stewy
TEXT: Stewy is a happy, excited boy who brings fun and energy wherever he goes! He’s playful, full of personality, and absolutely loves a good round of zoomies to burn off his enthusiasm. This lively lad enjoys engaging with his people and will happily come over for pats, attention, and of course — cuddles. After a burst of play, he’s more than ready to snuggle up and soak in the affection. Stewy would suit a home that enjoys an interactive, playful companion and is ready to embrace his joyful spirit. If you’re looking for a dog who will make you smile every single day, Stewy might just be your perfect match. 💙

NAME: Hazel
TEXT: Meet Hazel 🌿 Hazel is a sweet girl with a placid, gentle nature that makes her a lovely companion. She has a quiet charm about her and thrives in a peaceful, steady environment. Hazel will need a little time to warm up to a new home, as new surroundings can feel overwhelming at first. With patience, reassurance, and a calm household, she will gradually come out of her shell and show her affectionate and loyal personality. She would do best in a calm home where she can settle at her own pace and build confidence. A slow and thoughtful introduction to a cat will be important, and she could be workable with a small dog companion with the right match and gentle introductions.

NAME: Aurora
TEXT: Aurora is a sweet, cuddly girl with a gentle heart and a loving nature. She adores affection and will happily soak up all the pats and snuggles once she feels safe and settled. She may be a little timid at first when meeting new people or adjusting to a new environment, but with patience and reassurance in a calm home, Aurora will soon blossom into a devoted and affectionate companion. Aurora would thrive in a semi-active household that enjoys a balance of relaxed downtime and daily walks or playtime. She is suitable for families with children of all ages, especially in a home that encourages kind and gentle interactions. With a slow and positive introduction, she could be workable with a small dog companion. If you’re looking for a soft, loving girl who will reward your patience with cuddles and loyalty, Aurora could be your perfect match. 🐾💕

NAME: Mavis
TEXT: Meet Mavis 🤍 Mavis is a gentle, sweet-natured girl looking for a calm and chilled home where she can truly relax and feel safe. She has a quiet presence and would thrive in a semi-active household that enjoys a balance of peaceful downtime and relaxed walks. She may be a little timid when first settling in, but with patience and reassurance, Mavis will gradually warm up and show her affectionate, loyal personality. Once she feels secure, she forms lovely bonds with her people and enjoys simply being nearby. Mavis would be best suited to a home with older children who can respect her space and understand her gentle nature. A slow and considered introduction to cats and small dogs will be important to help her adjust comfortably. She would particularly suit a part-time or work-from-home household, or an older couple looking for a devoted companion to share their days with.

NAME: Licorice
TEXT: Licorice is a big, sooky boy with an even bigger heart. He absolutely loves being around his people and thrives on companionship, affection, and attention. If you’re looking for a loyal shadow who wants to be part of everything you do, Licorice is your guy. He enjoys an active lifestyle and will happily join you for walks and playtime, but his new family will need to be mindful of his leg and ensure his exercise is appropriate and not overly strenuous. A balanced routine that keeps him engaged without overdoing it will suit him best. Licorice can be prone to separation anxiety, so he would do best in a home where someone works from home or is around for much of the day. Alternatively, a well-matched female dog friend could help keep him company and build his confidence when left alone. Due to his size and excitability, Licorice would be best suited to a home with older children who can handle his enthusiasm and help maintain calm, consistent boundaries.

NAME: Shayla
TEXT: My Shayla! Shayla is an affectionate girl who would love some human company to be by her side. She is learning to settle on her own and would do best with structure and someone home more often than not. A quiet, calm home with no children or other dogs would see Shayla settle in the best. Kids aged 16+ with greyhound experience would be the best fit, or experienced greyhound owners who can support a high energy dog who loves activity. She is a highly affectionate girl who loves her toys and treats. She walks perfectly on the lead for adventures, and is the bubbly, happy easy going type girl around people. She mingles nicely with other dogs but would prefer not to live with one. She'd love a home with a yard for zoomies and her random fun outburts of energy. She has experience travelling well in cars as well. My Shayla.... Meet her today at Western Sydney!

NAME: Maple
TEXT: Meet Maple 🍁 Maple is a beautiful, placid girl with a gentle soul and a sweet nature. She has a calm presence that makes her a wonderful addition to a relaxed, loving home. Maple can be a little timid when first meeting new people or adjusting to new surroundings, but with a bit of patience and reassurance, she will slowly come out of her shell. Once she feels safe and comfortable, her affectionate and loyal personality truly shines. She would thrive in a calm household with a semi-active lifestyle — a home that enjoys a balance of quiet downtime and leisurely walks or play sessions. Maple is suitable for families with children of all ages, especially where kindness and gentle interactions are encouraged. With the right introduction, she would be workable with a small dog companion.

NAME: Tilly
TEXT: Meet Tilly Sweet 💕 Tilly Sweet is a placid, gentle girl with a heart as soft as her name. She has a calm and loving nature, making her a wonderful companion for a family looking for a sweet and steady presence in their home. While Tilly may be a little timid when first meeting new people or entering a new environment, she warms up beautifully when given a calm, reassuring space to settle in. Once she feels comfortable, her playful side shines through — she absolutely loves a good zoomie around the yard and enjoys spending time playing with her favourite toys. Tilly would suit a semi-active household where she can enjoy both relaxed downtime and some fun bursts of activity. She’s treat motivated, which makes training a rewarding experience and a great way to continue building her confidence. She could be workable with a small dog companion and would do best with a slow, gentle introduction to a cat. Tilly is suitable for a home with children of all ages, especially in an environment where interactions are calm and respectful as she continues to grow in confidence.

NAME: Sammy
TEXT: Sammy is a stunning & friendly, happy-go-lucky boy who loves life, loves people, and especially loves kids. His favourite pastime is playing ball with his 10-year-old best mate — whether it’s kicking around a soccer ball or chasing a bouncing basketball, Sammy is always ready for fun. He has a high food drive, loves jumping in a clam pool, settles nicely in a crate and has even mastered how to go "down" on cue! He is happy to live with another dog his size, however not a requirement. He can also walk up and down stairs! Full of playful energy in short bursts, Sammy is just as happy to flop down afterward for a well-earned rest. He enjoys going for walks, spending time with his humans, and soaking up all the attention he can get. Sammy has shown he can settle nicely indoors, but a backyard for zoomies and chilling out would be best. A neighbourhood with a low small dog population is the best fit. Sammy would make a fantastic family dog for homes with kids or a loving companion for couples. With his sweet nature, playful spirit, and easy-going charm, he’s the perfect mix of fun and affections. Sammy is available at Western Sydney.

NAME: Addison
TEXT: Meet Addison 🐾 Addison is the sweetest 4-year-old girl who will completely steal your heart. With her adorable personality and affectionate nature, it’s impossible not to fall in love with her. To say Addison enjoys a cuddle and a pat is truly an understatement — she absolutely adores affection and will happily soak up all the love you’re willing to give. Her gentle, loving nature and beautiful soul melt the hearts of everyone she meets, she would fit well into a home with smaller dogs too. Addison is the kind of girl who will quickly become the centre of the family, bringing warmth, companionship and plenty of cuddles to her lucky forever home.

NAME: Annie
TEXT: Meet Annie 🐾 An energetic girl with loads of personality, who loves to run around the backyard either with toys or other dogs. She also loves water and enjoys splashing in her shell pool. Annie gets along with other greyhounds and little dog breeds (Poodle, Pug, Foxy, Jug). She is very friendly, loves pats and all the attention she can get! Annie is easy to walk on the lead and enjoys a car ride, just a delightful balance of joy and cuddles to have around. She would be most suited to a family (kids 6+) or active people with a nice yard to run about in. 💖

NAME: Jaxson
TEXT: Meet Jackson 🤍🐾 Jackson is a smaller, gentle and kind boy with a quiet and loving nature. He’s not overly active, preferring the simple pleasures in life, like pottering around the garden by your side or relaxing indoors close to his people. He can be a little shy when first meeting someone new, but give him a little time and you’ll see his beautiful personality shine through. Once he's settled in, Jackson is incredibly sweet, loyal, and affectionate. Jackson enjoys a bit of fun too! He loves water play and splashing around in his clam pool, and he’s wonderful to take out for a relaxed walk or a car ride. He’s happy to join you on outings but is just as content curling up inside, sneaking onto your bed if he gets the chance! He has experience living around smaller breeds like Pugs, Jugs, Foxies, and Shih Tzus, and would suit a home with small dogs or larger dogs who are friendly and easy-going. Jackson would thrive in a quieter household, perhaps with a couple who are home often, or a family with calm children aged 10 and over💛

NAME: Ferb
TEXT: Fabulous Ferby is looking for his forever home! Ferb is a super loving and affectionate guy who will go up to anyone and everyone and snuggle right into them! He steals the heart of everyone he meets and we just adore him! Ferb loves his humans so much that he would prefer a home where someone is around more often than not. However, Ferb also loves other medium-large size dogs and would gladly have a canine brother or sister for company while you are away at work. Ferb loves his food and is responding very well to training her at GAP HQ - he already walks perfectly on loose lead, recalls well, has been fantastic with toilet training, can lay down when asked and can walk up and down stairs. What a clever boy! Ferb would gladly share his home with older, respectful kids who would enjoy his affectionte nature but are also able to give him space when he needs a break. A quieter home without too much hustle and bustle beyond the fence is best suited for Ferb. This beautiful and sweet boy is going to be such an amazing pet. Apply to adopt Ferb today!

NAME: Benny
TEXT: Come and meet Mr Personality himself, Benny, at Western Sydney! Whether it's posing for photos or playing with toys, Benny has an amazing personality he can't wait to share with you. This sweet, handsome, happy and charming boy is very friendly and will love to soak up attention from anyone. He loves food BUT! He loves toys more, and is a very motivated and eager to please type boy. He engages with enrichment like a champ, showing off his skills as he works through puzzle toys and snuffle mats, keeping him entertained while you're gone. He can coexist nicely with other greyhounds and can be rehomed along side one, but doesn't seem to need a dog friend in his life and would be comfortable as a solo pet. Older kids would suit Benny as he does like to check out what treats or toys might be in your hands! Benny dreams of a townhouse/backyard with an outdoor area, and would be happy to show you his skills on staircases if you have stair access. As a solo pet, a half day left alone is suitable at this stage. Meet this one of a kind boy at Western Sydney.

NAME: Boris
TEXT: Boris is a stunning and gentle boy who can't wait to meet you! Boris is a sweet boy who has learnt lots of things during his time at GAP including being able to walk nicely on lead. He also has a high food drive making him very trainable. Due to his ability to settle alone inside (when in GAP office), in conjunction with crate training to manage toilet training, he can work up to become an inside dog. He is happy to be left independently when you're out at work and would suit full time workers with a backyard or a courtyard ground floor unit. Boris would prefer to be the only pet in the home but has paired well in the past in controlled exposures. An owner who has experience with sight hounds would be the best as he is still learning to be around smaller breeds of dogs. He would suit a home with older children as he is a gentle and respectable and loves a pat. Meet Boris at Western Sydney!

NAME: Manny
TEXT: Meet Manny 🐾 Manny is a beautiful 4-year-old greyhound with a lovely nature and a happy, playful personality. She’s an affectionate girl who enjoys getting out for a walk and soaking up plenty of pats and attention from her people. Manny has been workable around small dogs and, with the right introductions, could settle nicely into a home with canine friends. She’s a bright, friendly girl who loves being part of the action but also enjoys relaxing with her family. With her cheerful personality and loving nature, Manny would make a wonderful companion and a delightful addition to a lucky family looking for a sweet, playful greyhound.

NAME: Stanley
TEXT: Stanley is lovely, friendly, soft-natured boy who loves to cuddle. He has a quiet nature and just loves to be around you and check out what you're doing as you go about your day - a sticky beak! He is an easy-going, gentle lad who will be your best friend. Stanley is the perfect gentleman and companion for retirees or workers, he doesn't need much of a walk or trips in the car, he's just happy to hang about at home. Stanley isn’t an energetic boy, very easy-care who would make a wonderful pet, also great with the grandchildren 9 and 13 when they come to visit. 🐾💙

NAME: Dante
TEXT: Dante is a friendly and affectionate little girl (25kg) who loves people, pats and cuddles once she gets to know you and is gentle with kids 8+. She enjoys car rides around town, walks well on lead, loves to play with her soft toys and splash in the her shell pool outside, while also enjoying time inside where she is housetrained and lies in her crate or on her bed, sleeping happily with her legs up in the air, even showering with you! Dante will make a loving family pet or companion, with or without another doggie friend. She is used to other greyhounds but can spend time on her own. A quiet household would suit her best and she will be a loyal friend you will fall in love with 💖🐾

NAME: Ryan
TEXT: *Hi I'm Ryan, I'm in a foster home!* Ryan has just come back from a foster care home over Christmas — keep reading to find out why his foster carer loved him so much! "Ryan is the most beautiful, special boy with the loveliest and goofy personality that lights up a room. He settled into our home quickly and absolutely loved being around people; happily meeting new faces with his gentle nature. He adores pats and cuddles, often coming up to us for affection and even attempting to lay on top of us just to be close. Ryan is beautifully behaved on the lead and comfortably wears his muzzle, making outings a breeze. He’s a very well-mannered boy who would never jump on benches or steal food, and he patiently waits for his meals like a true gentleman. He loves adventures, from beach trips where he’d happily lay by the waves, to enjoying the rain, playing with boxes/teddies/balls and his favourite sleeping position is sprawled on his back on the couch or floor with his legs in the air without a care in the world. Ryan is such a special soul, and we truly hope he finds the perfect forever home because he deserves all the love and happiness in the world." Ryan would suit a full-time working family, with a backyard. He is outgoing and friendly with people, loves treats and would also suit a home with another medium-large canine companion. Ryan loves his walks around the adoption centre (pictured!) — and did we mention he’s super smart? 🐾 He already knows “on your bed,” “down,” and “shake,” among plenty of other tricks he’s learned in pet training. Ryan’s waiting for his new best friends to pick him up at the Western Sydney Adoption Centre — could that be you?

NAME: Messi
TEXT: Messi is a confident, excitable and friendly young boy. He would love a home with a yard where he can explore and smell all the interesting things in his new world. He enjoys time with people and would love a home that is willing to share adventures with him and continue teaching him about the best things in life. Messi would be happy to live with another dog who is happy to play and explore but also relax together. He enjoys going out for walks and would love to get some nice treats from a family ready to share their life with him. Available by appointment at Western Sydney

NAME: Rocco
TEXT: Rocco is a sweet and affectionate gentleman who can be a little shy at first but quickly decides he wants to be your cuddle buddy. He is a gentle middle-aged boy who has spent time with children and other dogs who respectfully shared space with him. Rocco has been getting used to the daily grind, walking in busy park areas meeting people and seeing dogs but he would also love a quiet yard to laze around in the sun. Rocco would be best suited to a canine companion who is quiet and calm like he is and also would prefer to live with calm, older children. He would love someone home to settle him in and spend time with him getting him used to your world and helping him grow his confidence and show his sweet, affectionate nature. Available by appointment at Western Sydney

NAME: Chumley
TEXT: Hi, I'm Chumley, a happy, social boy who likes to get to know new people and who would thrive in a home with a backyard, with older children. Chumley can live alongside another greyhound or M-L dog and would suit an easy going family who can take all things pet life slow as he learns about the world around him. Chumley has an overall confident, friendly nature and walks nicely on the lead. Chumley has spent some time travelling around with other greyhounds in the same car, so a home who enjoy travelling with their dogs is a good fit for him! Meet our man Chumley by appointment at Western Sydney.

NAME: Rusty
TEXT: Meet Rusty, your new best friend! Rusty is a calm and confident middle-aged man who would love a house or townhouse with a yard to enjoy. He would love to relax on the back porch with you watching children play or potentially run around the yard with a new canine companion. Rusty has spent time with children and loves his people so he would prefer to have someone home with him to give all his affection to. Rusty has met some other dogs and enjoys socializing, so he could live with a canine companion who matches his calm nature and enjoys an occasional play. Rusty is ready to make new friends; will you be his new bestie? Available by appointment at Western Sydney

NAME: Flo
TEXT: Hi, I'm Flo. I can be shy when I first meet you but I have met children ages 1+ in my past, and done well with polite introductions. A respectful, calm home would suit me the best. A home with a courtyard/yard would be great so I can have some space to explore. I have been polite around big and small dogs and can go home with a likeminded calm canine companion. I've gone on walks out and about and walk very nicely on the lead. A slow introduction to all things pet life will be the best approach as I am still learning. Once you get to know me I become friendly, outgoing and very cuddly! Meet me by appointment at Western Sydney.

NAME: Gus
TEXT: Hey, It's me, Gus! I am confident and have been around lots of different things before...cars, dams, different surfaces, radios and TV's, all in preparation to meet my forever family! I have gone for walks to the local shops and seen lots of things that make me a confident well rounded dog. I am an excellent traveller and would be a great match for a family who are on the road a bit and want to take their dog with them. I have met people on street walks and enjoy the attention, I would also suit a home with a calm small or large dog. Small dogs seem to like my vibe! My overall energy is calm, friendly with bouts of playfulness guess I am your quintessential greyhound... I hope to meet you soon. Meet me by appointment at Western Sydney!

NAME: Bindi
TEXT: Bindi is a superstar both on and off the track! With 26 wins under her belt, she’s now ready to trade the racetrack for a cozy couch. Confident and affectionate, she adores attention and loves a gentle pat. Bindi is clean, quiet, and travels well in the car. She’s happiest after a good walk, when she can settle down for a well-earned snooze in comfort. This charming girl is looking for a calm, loving home where she can enjoy the best of both adventure and relaxation.

NAME: Barry
TEXT: Barry is a calm and easy-going companion who’s been house-trained and home-raised—he’s never raced and brings a settled, gentle presence to any home. He walks beautifully on lead and enjoys a reassuring pat, making him a joy to have around. Barry gets along well with both small and large dogs, but he does need a cat-free home. His trainer has a preference for domestic re-homing, and with the right patient family, Barry will provide loyal companionship, calm company, and plenty of quiet affection.

NAME: Blake
TEXT: Blake is a sweet, people-focused boy who adores being part of the family. He’s fantastic with children, travels well, and walks beautifully on lead, making every outing a joy. Blake loves affection and happily seeks attention from those around him, thriving on companionship and family life. Social and respectful with both small and large dogs, he would fit seamlessly into a home with other pets or enjoy being the center of attention as the only dog. Blake is ready to share his loving, friendly nature with a family that appreciates his gentle, sociable spirit.

NAME: Artilla
TEXT: Artilla is an energetic greyhound with a zest for life and a love of adventure. Always ready to get out and explore, he would make a fantastic companion for someone who enjoys staying active and including their dog in everyday outings. This bright boy will thrive as the only dog in the home, where he can soak up all the attention and build a strong bond with his person. With time, patience, and gentle, consistent training, Artilla has all the potential to flourish into an incredibly rewarding companion. He’s looking for a committed owner who’s ready to invest in his development and guide him with kindness and encouragement. In return, Artilla will offer loyalty, enthusiasm, and a whole lot of love. If you’re searching for an adventure buddy and are excited about helping a dog reach his full potential, Artilla could be the perfect match. 💛

NAME: Ice
TEXT: Meet Ice Ice is a striking white and black boy with a confident, adventurous spirit, making him a wonderful companion for an active home. He’s eager to head out on walks and may be strong at first, but he settles as he goes. Ice travels well in the car, enjoys exploring new places and is happiest after a good adventure followed by some relaxation time with his people. Ice truly loves human company. He enjoys a pat and will seek out his people for connection. He is very food motivated, making training both fun and rewarding. He’s happiest enjoying his mealtimes separately from other dogs. Ice would be best suited as the only dog in the home, where he can enjoy his own space and routine while soaking up all the attention. If you’re looking for a confident, affectionate companion to share your walks and your downtime, Ice could be the perfect fit.

NAME: Bernie
TEXT: Bernie is a relaxed and confident greyhound who takes the world in his stride. With his calm outlook and steady nature, he handles new situations with ease and settles in beautifully wherever he goes. He loves exploring his surroundings and is always happy to head out on an adventure, whether it’s discovering a new walking track or simply enjoying a change of scenery. Curious yet composed, Bernie strikes the perfect balance between laid-back companion and enthusiastic explorer. Bernie would be an ideal match for someone looking for a loyal adventure buddy — a best friend who’s just as content out and about as he is unwinding at home afterwards. If you’re ready for a confident, easygoing partner to share life’s journeys, Bernie could be the one for you. 🐾

NAME: Nancy
TEXT: Nancy may be a little shy when you first meet her, but it doesn’t take long for her sweet personality to shine through. With a little reassurance and a gentle approach, she quickly warms up and soon leans in for the pats she secretly loves. Curious and playful, Nancy is a real “Dora the Explorer,” always eager to investigate her surroundings and see what’s going on. Whether she’s sniffing out new scents or checking out a new toy, her inquisitive nature makes every day an adventure. Nancy would truly thrive in a loving, patient home where she can continue to build her confidence, enjoy playful moments, and soak up plenty of affection. With the right family by her side, she’ll blossom into a devoted and joyful companion. 🐾

NAME: Nancy
TEXT: Nancy is a truly affectionate greyhound who simply adores people. A natural people-lover, she thrives on attention and is always eager to please everyone she meets. Her gentle, loving nature makes her an instant favourite with anyone lucky enough to spend time with her. Calm and confident, Nancy takes life in her stride. She enjoys a playful moment when the mood strikes, happily showing off her fun side, but she’s just as content curling up beside her favourite humans for a cuddle and plenty of pats. With her beautiful balance of playfulness and relaxation, Nancy would make a devoted, loving companion for a home ready to share plenty of affection. If you’re looking for a sweet soul who will happily be by your side, Nancy could be the perfect addition to your family. 🐾

NAME: Benji
TEXT: Benji is a sweet, confident greyhound with a heart as big as his long legs. He absolutely adores people and thrives on human company, happily soaking up every bit of love and attention he can get. Out on walks, Benji is a dream on the lead — calm, graceful, and a pleasure to stroll alongside. He also travels with ease, making him a wonderful companion for adventures near or far. Benji has a missing toe from an old injury, but it doesn’t slow him down one bit. He takes everything in his stride and lives life to the fullest, showing just how resilient and special he is. He would be happiest as the only dog in the home, where he can enjoy being the centre of attention and build a close, devoted bond with his people. If you’re looking for a loyal, loving companion who will bring warmth and elegance to your home, Benji could be your perfect match. 🐾

NAME: Barney
TEXT: If Barney's sweet and soulful eyes have caught your attention, keep reading to find out if you could be the perfect fit for our special guy, Barney. Barney is available to a home who can nurture a shy greyhound out of their shell. Barney requires a special home with a quiet lifestyle and a backyard with secure fencing where he can retreat to and enjoy the peace and quiet away from people when he needs it. A home without children is a must for our shy Barney, however a calm, wise and understanding dog of any size (small or large) would be a lovely companion to help him build his pet skills and help him adapt to his new life with his forever family. If you are someone who can provide a shy dog the structure, support, and ongoing confidence training that he needs to thrive as a pet, we'd love to hear from you. Barney is available for fostering or adoption by discussion with GAP team. We can't wait to hear from Barney's perfect family!

NAME: Tilly
TEXT: Tilly is a happy girl with the biggest smile and an even bigger heart. She has a playful, slightly goofy side that will keep you laughing, but at her core she’s a true people-lover who just wants to be near her humans. She’s very people-orientated and thrives on companionship, so a home where someone works from home or where she has another friendly dog to keep her company would suit her beautifully. Tilly is happiest when she’s part of the action and included in family life. Tilly would make a wonderful family dog. She could be workable with a small dog and even a cat, with the right introductions. She walks nicely on lead, enjoys getting out and about, and is very treat motivated — which makes ongoing training both fun and rewarding. She would love a home with a secure yard where she can stretch her legs, play, and soak up the sunshine before coming back inside for cuddles. If you’re looking for a loyal, loving, slightly goofy best friend with a permanent smile, Tilly might just be your perfect match. 💛

NAME: Leggy
TEXT: This handsome fellow is currently sharing a yard with another greyhound and spending time playing with a little Italian greyhound. He is very sweet and affectionate, loves to play and loves affection. Would be an excellent supervisor while your working in the yard.

NAME: Luna
TEXT: Luna is an energetic girl that enjoys a yard where she can cut loose in the morning and bust out some zoomies. Then like most greyhounds she's done, finished gone for the day and happy to cuddle up and relax. She shares a yard with Bubba and good left alone.

NAME: Jason
TEXT: Meet Jason, a sweet guy with lots of personality, ready to find a place to call home! Jason has spent some time in a home and is ready to step paws into his forever home. A home with a backyard or courtyard would best suit Jason, so he can do his zoomies or have a snooze in the sun. He can be a little shy at first but with a few scratches behind the ear and a couple treats, you'll win him over in no time! A home with quiet children is best suited, so Jason can enjoy the serenity. Jason gets along well with his Greyhound mates, so a home with another medium to large dog could work for him, pending a meet and greet. Available at Western Sydney!

NAME: Malley
TEXT: Hi, I'm Malley! I've been learning lots of things about the world while I wait to be adopted. I am super friendly and will make a sensational first impression, if I do say so myself! I am very charming and think you will just love me! I know what a lounge is, how to navigate those weird things called "stairs", and have enjoyed spending time in an open crate, and spending time indoors, too. I'm a good traveller, I also love toys and treats and my handlers call me a big softie! I would prefer short hours alone as a solo pet and a slow intro to the big wide world as my horizons slowly expand as a pet with you. If you thought you might like a big affectionate softie like me simply reach out to the Western Sydney adoption centre :)

NAME: Emily
TEXT: Emily is a warm, people-focused gal who has been making lovely progress during her time at GAP. She is bright and responsive, quickly picking up new skills and showing a great willingness to learn. Training sessions are something she genuinely enjoys, especially when food rewards are involved! In new or unfamiliar settings, Emily can be a little reserved at first, but she adjusts quickly once she feels safe and supported. As her confidence grows, her affectionate and engaging personality really shines through. Emily would be best suited as the only pet in the home. She is most comfortable without the presence of other animals and will thrive in an environment where she can relax without needing to share her space. She would be suitable for a home with respectful children. A house with a secure yard would be ideal, giving her room to stretch out and decompress. She is still building confidence with stairs and is progressing steadily, but a home with minimal stairs — or a patient approach while she continues learning — would be beneficial. Initially, Emily would do best in a home where someone is around most of the time, with only short periods of alone time as she transitions. With routine and consistency, her independence can continue to develop. Emily is a clever, affectionate girl who is well on her way to becoming a wonderful companion. In the right home, she will reward her family with loyalty, warmth and steady progress.

NAME: Rex
TEXT: Rex is a people-loving greyhound who thrives on attention and connection. If you’re looking for a companion who enjoys being part of your day and happily soaks up affection, Rex will be right by your side. He’s highly motivated by food, which makes him responsive and engaged, and he settles beautifully in his crate when it’s time to relax. While toys aren’t really his thing, human company certainly is. Rex has socialised well with other greyhounds and could share his home with a compatible medium to large canine friend, though he would be just as happy as the only dog. He would be suitable for a family with respectful children and has shown a calm and affectionate nature in his interactions with people. Rex has demonstrated that he settles best indoors and enjoys the comfort of home life. A townhouse with at least a small courtyard would be ideal, giving him a bit of outdoor space to stretch his legs and unwind. Initially, Rex may be best suited to a home where he has someone home more often than not, while he adjusts, but he has shown an encouraging ability to self-settle. With gradual progression and routine, his capacity can continue to build. Rex is a warm, affectionate boy who is ready to enjoy the comforts of pet life. With structure, guidance and plenty of love, he will make a devoted and rewarding companion.

NAME: Bonnie
TEXT: Bonnie was breed to be on the couch, she likes to lounge around and keep it real. She is a pretty girl that looks like she would suit the apartment lifestyle.

NAME: Cheesey
TEXT: Meet Cheesey – Your Loyal, Lovable Sidekick 🐾 Cheesey is a lovely-natured boy with a gentle, caring heart. He absolutely adores kids aged 10–13 and thrives on attention, pats, and plenty of love. When you come home, he’ll greet you with happy excitement, then quickly settle down after pats and play, content just to be by your side. On walks, Cheesey is a dream - once he get sgoing he happily strolls at your pace and enjoys taking in the world with you. After a nice walk and a zoom around the yard or some fun with his toys, he’s more than ready to flop on the floor for a well-earned rest. He’s attentive, loyal, and eager to please, making him a very trainable companion. Cheesey loves splashing in his water bowl or cooling off in a shell pool — he’s got a playful streak and a bit of a cheeky character that will keep you smiling. Importantly, Cheesey is also wonderfully patient and independent. He’s perfectly happy to relax on his own during the day if you’re at work - no fuss, no hassle. Just a steady, easygoing boy waiting for his people to come home. 🐾💙

NAME: Max
TEXT: Max is a beautiful active boy who loves to go on adventures max is suited to full time workers max loves older kids as he loves to play with toys and can sometimes forget his size with younger children. despite his energy max walks very well on lead max requires a larger fenced area to ensure he stays in the backyard all day as he can sometimes want to go and hang out around the neighbourhood. max is a clean and healthy boy and would suit your more active lifestyle

NAME: Dot
TEXT: Meet Dot !! Dot is a gentle, steady girl who is beginning to settle well into home life. She enjoys exploring, relaxing with her people, and she absolutely loves the water. Dot gets on well with all dogs and has a calm, social nature that makes her easy to have around. She’s learning the rhythm of household living and is taking everything in her stride. With her sweet temperament and easygoing personality, Dot is ready to find a home where she can continue to grow in confidence. If you’re looking for a loving companion to share your heart and home, Dot might be the perfect Valentine match.

NAME: Maizie
TEXT: Meet Maizie 🐾💖 Maizie is a lively, playful greyhound bursting with energy and personality! She’d thrive in a home with a secure yard where she can stretch her legs, zoom to her heart’s content, and enjoy the great outdoors. A confident canine companion would be the perfect match for Maizie – she loves the company of other dogs and enjoys having a buddy by her side. With her fun-loving nature, Maizie is best suited to a home with older children who can keep up with her zest for life. She absolutely lives for treats, adores affection, and isn’t shy about handing out face licks as her signature love language! If you’re looking for a smart, affectionate greyhound who’s full of beans and full of love, Maizie is ready to join your family and brighten your days (and maybe even steal your heart…)

NAME: Hope
TEXT: Meet Hope, a sweet and gentle soul who's ready to bring warmth and companionship into your life. Her quiet nature is truly heartwarming, making her an ideal companion for anyone seeking a serene presence. Hope is crate trained, offering peace of mind when you need it. Her adaptable nature enables her to live comfortably in a variety of environments, from small apartments to more spacious homes. Hope is a social butterfly when it comes to her fellow canines. Whether large or small, she gets along famously with dogs of all sizes. If you're looking for a sweet, quiet, and gentle companion, Hope is sure to become a beloved member of your family.

NAME: Adal
TEXT: Adal – A Big Hunk of Love! Adal is the sweetest, affectionate boy with a big heart and just as much love to give. He’s great with all people, always happy to see you, excitable at times and loves showering you with kisses. This easy-going lad enjoys his walks, car rides, playtime with his toys, and hanging out with his greyhound friends, as well as playing with the resident Whippet and Jack Russell. With his lovely nature, happy personality, and endless love to share, Adal will make a wonderful companion, especially if someone is home, though he can be on his own or with another dog to play with. 💙

NAME: Ocean
TEXT: Adorable, playful boy Ocean is looking for a new place to call home! Ocean is an outgoing and friendly boy best known for his goofy, playful bursts that will have you laughing! At 6-years-old, Ocean is a little more relaxed and those playful spurts don't last long before he needs a good recharge nap, making him an easy pet! Ocean is pretty easy-going and doesn't mind spending a few hours alone while his humans are away, provided you live in a quieter neighbourhood without too much hustle and bustle going on beyond the fence. Ocean gets along well with other medium-large dogs and is also suitable for living with older, respectful children. We just know Ocean is going to bring his forever family so much love and joy! He is waiting for you at our Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Toby (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Happy and handsome blue boy Toby is a friendly, confident and social boy who loves to recieve praise and treats. He would suit a home with a home with some hours alone during the day, and can live alongside another greyhound. He has also become friends with a Labrador! An owner willing to continue his training around smaller breeds of dogs will see Toby succeed as he would benefit from ongoing exposure. He can walk up and down stairs and would love a backyard to call his own, however he settles best in indoor settings. A family who will include him in the daily activities of family life will be a great fit. Older/teen kids would be the best match for his occasionally bouncy nature. Meet Toby at Western Sydney!

NAME: Lilo
TEXT: Lilo loves to feel the earth under her feet and be in the yard but she does also like affection and being close the ones she loves. She likes the water and cooling down on hot days. She will inspect new people she meets and will come around once she approves.

NAME: Stitch
TEXT: Stitch has lived around farm animals and native animals most of her life so she is unbothered by a lot of things. She may get excited but she calms down quite quickly. She is very confident and happy and would love a yard to look after.

NAME: Rapunzel
TEXT: Rapunzel loves any form of affection. She will come to you when called, she is confident and not bothered by much in life.

NAME: Lulu
TEXT: Lulu isn't bothered by the sheep and native animals that surround her. She is a happy go lucky girl that is very confident and ready to explore new places.

NAME: Geno
TEXT: Meet Geno, a sweet and happy boy who's sure to steal your heart with his wagging tail and bright eyes, as he loves nothing more than receiving pats from everyone he meets. Geno is a sociable pup who revels in the company of other dogs. His friendly demeanor means he'll quickly become a beloved member of any dog-friendly household. He's a fan of good meals and thoroughly enjoys his food. One of Geno's most endearing qualities is his love for the water. Geno loves to splash in his paddle pool and Geno is the perfect companion for those who appreciate a mix of play and relaxation. If you're looking for a sweet, happy dog who's as charming as he is friendly, Geno could be the perfect match for you. With Geno, every day is an opportunity for fun, affection, and shared experiences.

NAME: Dex
TEXT: Meet Dex, the strikingly handsome and robust canine companion who loves for water and has a zest for life, Dex is the ideal pet for those who appreciate an adventurous soul . Dex exudes strength and charm, preferring the company of larger dogs who match his playful energy and enthusiasm. Whether he's splashing around in a pool, pond, or simply enjoying a sunny day outdoors, Dex is happiest when he's with his big-sized friends. Toys are another passion of Dex's; he enjoys the simple pleasures of tug-of-war or a good game of fetch. His playful antics with his toys will surely keep you entertained. While he adores the companionship of big dogs, he prefers a home without small dogs to ensure everyone's comfort and harmony. Dex's energetic nature would thrive in a home with an active lifestyle, spacious yard, or access to dog-friendly outings. Embrace the adventure and heartwarming fun that Dex brings to every day. Are you ready to welcome a strong, water-loving, toy-enthusiast into your life.

NAME: Cheeky
TEXT: Cheeky is a joyful, energetic girl whose name says it all! She’s bursting with personality, always ready for an adventure, and guaranteed to bring a smile to your face. Cheeky has a playful, spirited nature. Whether she’s zooming around the yard, exploring new places, or showing off her silly side, she brings excitement and joy to every day. She thrives on activity and engagement, perfect for someone who enjoys a lively companion. Her zest for life is contagious! Despite all her energy, Cheeky has a beautifully soft side. She’s incredibly affectionate and loves being close to her humans, soaking up cuddles and attention whenever she can.

NAME: Asha
TEXT: Asha is a sweet and loyal greyhound with a gentle personality and a heart big enough for everyone she meets. She’s the perfect mix of affectionate companion and playful friend. 💛 Sweet & Loyal Asha bonds deeply with her people and loves being part of the action. Whether she’s leaning in for cuddles or trotting happily beside you, she’s all about love and connection. 🐶 Great With Other Dogs One of her standout traits is how beautifully she gets along with other dogs. She’s friendly, social, and thrives in the company of canine buddies. ✨ Why You’ll Love Asha Sweet, gentle, and people‑focused Fun-loving with a soft, joyful personality Gets along wonderfully with other dogs Loyal and affectionate

NAME: Kota
TEXT: 🌸 Meet Kota - A Gentle Soul Looking for a Patient, Loving Home Kota is a very special girl with a soft heart and a sensitive spirit. She may take a little while to warm up, but once she trusts you, she forms deep, meaningful bonds that make every moment worth the wait. 💗 A Sensitive, Quiet Beauty Kota can feel a bit unsure in new environments, and she prefers to take things slowly. She’s not the kind of dog who rushes into new situations, she observes, thinks, and opens up at her own pace. But beneath that initial shyness is a truly affectionate, loyal companion. 🏡 Needs a Calm, Patient Home Kota will thrive in a warm, gentle, and patient household where she can feel safe and loved. She’ll do best with people who understand that trust takes time, and who are happy to give her the space and reassurance she needs to blossom.

NAME: Ray
TEXT: Hey, I'm Ray! You could say I am a ray of sunshine, I'm so friendly and vibrant and ready to light up your life! 🔆 I will give you cuddles, licks and give you an amazing first impression with my confident personality. My best suited home is a home who loves all things greyhounds - from my zoomies to my naps. I love zoomies and play, and I will be your sweet and joyful companion who will always be wiggly and cute when you get home from work. I will run around and keep you active, so a home with a yard is going to be great for me and my sunshine personality! I can be excited to get going on the lead but I will be eager to learn and walk nicely once we get into routine. My best suited home is one with shorter hours alone while I settle in, I can also go home with a medium to large canine companion. If you need some more rays of sunshine in your life, come and meet me at Western Sydney!

NAME: Jack
TEXT: Jack is a friendly and confident boy who genuinely enjoys human interaction and being part of the family. He’s comfortable travelling and is happy to join you on outings, making him a great companion for an on-the-go lifestyle. Jack is best suited to a home with other large dogs or greyhounds and would not be suitable for homes with small dogs or birds. On lead, he can be a little excitable at first, but once given clear direction he settles quickly and walks along nicely. With guidance, consistency, and plenty of affection, Jack will make a loyal and engaging addition to the right home.

NAME: Erroll
TEXT: Erroll is a confident, playful boy who loves engaging with both people and other dogs. Full of energy and boisterous fun, he thrives on walks, playtime, and being right in the middle of the action. Whether it’s heading out for an adventure or joining in on social time, Erroll is always keen to be involved. Despite his lively nature, Erroll is also able to settle comfortably, making him a great balance of fun and companionship. He’d suit a home that can keep up with his enthusiasm and enjoy sharing life with a dog who brings joy, confidence, and plenty of personality.

NAME: Lionel
TEXT: Lionel is a confident and friendly boy who absolutely loves people and greets life with a curious, playful spirit. Well-behaved and affectionate, he enjoys being involved in whatever’s going on around him and would suit an active, loving home where he can share daily walks and quality time. Lionel is happiest when he’s with his best buddy Hazel, and the two share a special bond. If you’re able to welcome them both, you’ll be rewarded with a perfectly matched pair who bring companionship, fun, and plenty of heart into the home.

NAME: Hazel
TEXT: Hazel is a beautiful blue female greyhound with a calm, confident, and sweet-natured personality. She loves attention and will happily respond when you call her name, always ready for a gentle pat or some quiet company. Hazel gets along well with other dogs and would thrive in a home that offers a yard and regular companionship. She shares a special bond with her friend Lionel, and if you have room in your heart and home for two, Hazel would absolutely love to stay by his side. With her gentle presence and loving nature, Hazel would make a wonderful, loyal companion.

NAME: Rodney
TEXT: Rodney is a stunning black male greyhound with a shiny coat and a full-of-beans personality to match. He’s an excitable, playful boy who brings joyful energy wherever he goes, but don’t let that fool you—he absolutely melts for pats and affection. Rodney would thrive in a home that enjoys daily walks and a bit of fun, as he loves getting out and about and stretching his long legs. He enjoys the company of other larger breed dogs and is happy to share his space, but he’s just as content soaking up someone’s full attention and being the star of the show. With his playful spirit and loving nature, Rodney is the kind of dog who will keep you smiling and fill your home with warmth (and the occasional zoomie). If you’re looking for a fun-loving companion with a big heart, Rodney might just be your perfect match 💛

NAME: Billy (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Hey, Billy here! I'm a cheerful & sweet guy with a gentle nature. I walk nicely on the lead and promise to go on a laid back dawdle around the block peacefully with you. Because I am gentle and loving, I'm also polite around big and small dogs on walks and can go home with another medium to large breed canine companion. A home with respectful children would be suitable for me. I am a good traveller in the car, and have no issue around things like lawnmowers, vans, foot traffic on walkies, etc and would be the kind of dog to take things in my stride! A home with a yard or a small courtyard would be great so I have somewhere to chill out when I want to. Come meet me at Western Sydney by appointment!

NAME: Scoot
TEXT: Scoot is a gentle and kind boy, well mannered with a really lovely temperament. He will wait his turn and is patient around other greys and little dogs including a mini poodle, Shih Tzus and a Pug. Scoot is happy, friendly, fun-loving and an easy going all-rounder. He's loves a bit of a zoomie in the morning and a walk in the afternoon or a play in the yard, especially splashing in his shell pool, then just as happy to flop down and chill out. He's great with kids 8-10+ but it's in his nature to be gentle with younger kids 5+ as well. Scoot will laze about watching or follow you around as you go about your daily chores; he likes to check out what you're doing whether that's gardening, being in the shed, going for a walk or off to feed the chickens before dinner and bedtime. He's also fine with workers and being outside all day, where he gets along with other dogs, big and small. Scoot Scoot would make a loving loyal companion or family pet who just wants to be your best friend. 💙

NAME: Lily
TEXT: Lily is a sensitive, nervous girl who’s looking for a patient and loving home where she can continue to build her confidence at her own pace. She’s currently working on exposure in a home environment and is making progress with calm, supportive guidance. Lily has been around small dogs, though she’ll need slow, safe introductions and careful management as she settles in. A quiet household with understanding humans who are happy to let her take things one step at a time would suit her best. With kindness, consistency, and a little extra love, Lily has the potential to blossom into a wonderful companion.

NAME: Shelby
TEXT: Shelby is a very energetic greyhound who’s always ready to go. She’s best suited to an active lifestyle with plenty of opportunities to burn off her energy and enjoy structured play. If Shelby is rehomed with another dog, she’ll need an experienced owner and a canine companion who can truly match her energetic play style. She plays hard and would do best with a confident, compatible dog who enjoys the same level of activity. A secure backyard is a must for Shelby, giving her the space she needs to run, play, and unwind. In the right home, Shelby will thrive as a fun, lively companion for someone who loves an active dog.

NAME: Lenny
TEXT: Lenny is a beautiful male greyhound who knows exactly what he likes—and he likes his own space. He’d be happiest as a solo dog, where he can fully relax and enjoy being the center of attention. Out and about, Lenny is perfectly fine around other dogs and handles public settings well, but he’s not a fan of other dogs getting too close in his personal bubble. Because of this, he’s best suited to a home where he can have his space respected. Lenny would thrive in a semi-active household and is accustomed to being handled by kids, making him a great option for a family that understands dog boundaries. He’s a lovely boy with lots to offer the right home.

NAME: Roger
TEXT: Roger is a handsome black greyhound with a calm, easygoing vibe. He’s a pretty chill dude who enjoys a relaxed lifestyle and doesn’t ask for much beyond comfort, kindness, and a good routine. Roger would do best as a solo dog or with a female canine companion. He can be workable with small dogs and even cats, given the right introductions and management. His laid-back nature makes him a great match for full-time workers or a family looking for a low-key, affectionate dog. If you’re after a gentle, uncomplicated companion who’s happy to go with the flow, Roger might just be your guy.

NAME: Mickey
TEXT: Mickey is a gorgeous white and blue male greyhound with a truly lovely personality — and he’s a smaller boy too, which just adds to his charm. He’s sweet, gentle, and a pleasure to have around. Mickey has spent time in a house and is comfortable being indoors, though he hasn’t lived full-time inside yet. He can manage stairs going up, but will need some support and patience with coming back down as he continues learning. He is workable with small dogs and, with the right slow and careful introductions, may also be cat workable. His future family will need to be prepared to put in the time and consistency to help him succeed, but Mickey’s kind nature makes him well worth the effort.

NAME: Fang
TEXT: Fang is a striking white and red brindle male greyhound with a gentle, sensitive nature. He walks nicely on lead and enjoys getting out for calm, relaxed strolls. When first meeting new people, Fang can be a little nervous and appreciates a slow, patient approach. He will come over for pats, but prefers things to be taken at his pace — once he feels safe, he settles beautifully and shows his sweet, trusting side.
