Lucy shows interest in wanting to be a part of a family, grow, learn how to be confident & playful, she just needs that support & encouragement to do so. A quiet home at first would be ideal. Lucy has spent time indoors, around children & a smaller breed of dog. With the correct introduction & supervision, Lucy may become best friends with your smaller fluff's. Please reach out if you would like to meet Lucy :)

NAME: Red
TEXT: This is our boy Red. Say hello to this charming boy who is looking for his forever home. Red is relaxed on lead, great to handle, making your daily walks very enjoyable. He has had frequent exposure to leisurely strolls in town and enjoys the slow paced lifestyle. He is very friendly and will stop for pats or to say hello. At times Red can be apprehensive in new environments. Once he has found his feet, he takes the world in his stride and settles into a happy pace of life. He would suit a quieter home with any humans, big or small, that are willing to give him all of the love in the world.

NAME: Stacey
TEXT: Meet our sweet girl Stacey. Stacey warms up after a little bit of attention but initially she could be weary of her surroundings. She has spent time around children and is gentle around them. Stacey is responsive on lead but will like to sniff around as well.

NAME: Benji
TEXT: Are you after a playful and cheeky friend? Benji is after his forever home! He is all things cheeky, confident and cunning. Benji is responsive on lead but some extra training wouldn't go astray. He loves a pat and to bound around a yard big or small, he would be suitable to live in a townhouse or villa and would in time be able to conquer stairs. Benji had an injury in 2023 which he has now recovered from but has a plate in his hock. If you're interested in learning more about Benji, please apply now.

NAME: Paddy
TEXT: Mr Paddy! This gentle giant is such an easy-going, laid-back goof ball! He is always down to clown or just take it easy and rest his feet. He gets on well with smaller breeds of dogs- there's a Yorkie always saying hello :) Paddy interacts positively with new people, even younger children. He would love to have yard where he can run about, chasing toys thrown by his new best friends :)

NAME: Millie
TEXT: Looking for a sweetheart that loves children, engaging in fun play & snuggling? Then Millie is the girl for you! Millie is very excitable & playful! Loves to run around being a little silly & cheeky. Quick to jump in a body of water.... even on picture day hehe :)

NAME: Chucky
TEXT: Sweet & adorable older gal. Independant & confident. Will adpat to full time workers. Has spent time around young grandchildren. Relaxed in new spaces & around new people. Sister to Storm! Would you consider welcoming both into your family?

NAME: Garnet
TEXT: **Garnet has lived in a foster home in the city CBD with full time workers, is affectionate and intelligent, and loves long walkies and would enjoy an active family to keep fit and go on daily adventures with** She's been a joy to foster! Here's a glimpse into Garnet's wonderful traits: - Garnet is an early bird who enjoys morning naps after joining you in bed. - A fearless adventurer, she's unbothered by much and walks in loud, busy city streets. - Walks in the rain without hesitation. - Patiently waits outside shops while you run quick errands. - Curious by nature, Garnet follows you around, eager to be part of your activities. - Loves to relax and roach on the couch. - Enjoys chasing Frisbees, balls, and playing with squeaky toys. - An exceptional office companion and assistant. - Incredibly friendly and affectionate, she welcomes pats from everyone she meets. - Gentle with children she meets. - Gets super excited about snacks, especially denta sticks! - Loves to taste a variety of foods, from peanut butter, hot chips, and banana. - Garnet has accompanied professional dog walkers, who have consistently praised how well she walks on the lead. Garnet has been a delight in the home, and I'm sure she'll make an excellent addition to a loving family. We’ll certainly miss her! If you're looking for a dog to fill your home with love and joy then apply to adopt the gorgeous Garnet today!

NAME: Pattie
TEXT: Meet Pattie, a gentle and gracious senior who has spent her life expertly spreading love and warmth. Pattie has been in the company of children and copes well with if they are polite and well mannered. Pattie is a well-mannered lady who carries herself with a polite serenity, she has been socialised with small dogs and although she would prefer a large companion she is polite around small dogs. Pattie has slowed in her senior years, but she would love a foster home where she can settle and would be the perfect companion for someone looking for an older calm companion.

NAME: Eve
TEXT: Meet Eve, a gentle and calm senior lady who's ready to grace your home with her presence. With her quiet and serene nature, Eve is the epitome of tranquility, and she effortlessly brings a sense of peace wherever she roams. Eve has a friendly disposition and a soulful gaze that speaks volumes. She's an observant girl who appreciates the simpler things in life, making her a suitable match for a loving individual or family seeking a mellow furry friend. As a senior dog, Eve would thrive in a foster home where she can enjoy her golden years in comfort. Her dream environment would be one filled with love, where she can relax while being treasured as the devoted companion she is. By welcoming Eve into your life, you'll not only be providing her with a secure and loving home, but you'll also be rewarded with the companionship of a truly special and lovable friend.

NAME: Katie
TEXT: Quote from foster career, We have loved getting to know Katie and giving her the opportunity to enjoy her new life as a pet. Being the older sister, she is very independent and settles very easily. She is very happy to sit on her bed whilst you work or go about your day. She is toilet trained and has fallen into her new routine very easily. She gets so excited to see us, as exemplified with her happy, whipping tail (duck for cover!). She tends to jump up on you when she’s very excited, but this is something we are working on and have already seen great improvements on. Katie walks well on a leash and doesn’t react negatively to other dogs, big or small. She has done well approaching small dogs and children and saying hello. Katie would be a great pet for a someone looking for an independent dog that will also shower you will love and affection. __________________________________________________________________________ Katie is a lovely hound. She is happy and confident, very playful. Does appreciate a good lay down also. Has been living in a rural setting is no stranger to native animals and is now in suburban foster care enjoying cuddly toys, living out the back and coming in the home for the evening.

NAME: Flash
TEXT: Flash is seeking an empathetic & nurturing owner who can follow a cooperative care plan to help with his daily eye medication. Could you be the perfect owner for our sweet boy? Flash has pannus, which means he needs daily eye medication. But don’t worry—he’s a star pupil when it comes to taking his meds & he’s getting better every day with the right guidance. Flash is currently learning all sorts of new tricks at the adoption centre. He is a fast learner and with a little time and practice, he's shown he can do amazing things. A large yard where Flash can stretch his legs and zoom around is a must! He loves a good run, and a big space is perfect for his energy. No small children or other animals. Flash would prefer a calm environment where he can be the only one getting your attention and affection. Flash is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre. **Flash is on daily medication - enquire with GAP for more info**

NAME: Spot
TEXT: Meet Spot, our distinguished older gentleman who is looking for the perfect match. Spot isn't just any dog; he carries himself with the grace and ease that only a seasoned greyhound can. Spot has had the pleasure of living in the serene setting of a granny flat, making him an expert in enjoying the quieter side of life. However, don’t let his age fool you; thanks to a thorough training program, Spot is sharp and responsive. He comes eagerly when his name is called and possesses a well-mannered set of tricks, including "touch" and "paws up," that make him a delight to teach and interact with. His training, combined with his naturally loyal temperament, makes Spot an excellent fit for a single person looking for a true companion. He understands the comforting routine of a single household and offers unwavering loyalty in return. Spot embodies the best qualities of an older dog. Devoted and endearing, he is ready to join someone who values thoughtful companionship and has room in their heart for a truly dignified and loving friend.

NAME: Raffa
TEXT: This bundle of joy loves human interaction and adventure. Raffa loves to run around his big yard area and shows you how fast he can be. Raffa gets very excited for the first five minutes you meet him before settling down. After getting his morning energy out and jumping around Raffa settles down and loves to lay in the sun. Raffa is fine around older kids and would make a great pet for a family with a big yard or a young couple who are fit and active.

NAME: Ronald
TEXT: Ronald is a cheerful, confident and friendly lad looking to bounce straight into your home. We know Ronald to be a charismatic, charming and affectionate boy. With these qualities in mind, we think he'd suit a family with children and preferably shorter hours alone while he begins to settle in. This beautiful boy is at the magical age of 7 where he has his lazy side but has moments of playfulness, too. A perfect blend for many family types! Did we mention he currently lives with another greyhound? He'd love it if you had another hound for a play mate and nap buddy. Get in touch with the Western Sydney centre to meet Ronald.

NAME: Baby
TEXT: Nobody puts baby in the corner! This little lady is looking to learn all about the world with you! She would suit short hours alone as a solo girl, or longer hours with a canine companion. Polite with dogs big or small, beautiful Baby has so much love to give and is searching for the right place to call home. If this Baby girl sounds like the perfect addition to your family, apply to take her home from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Irena
TEXT: Are you ready to be laughing with your newest furry friend? Well, Irena will have you cackling. She is a true definition of a little pocket rocket, she will be showing all aspects of her zoomies and how confident she is in doing so. Irena enjoys spending her days showing off and basking in the sunshine. She loves to have someone's full-attention so is best suited to being an only dog. Irena knows her name well and with a little bit of getting used to your voice she will come (running) straight back.

NAME: Ralph
TEXT: Are you after a little fire-cracker in your life? Look no further than our boy Ralph! He is all things active/fun-loving and absolutely hilarious; Ralph will have your grinning from ear to ear. Ralph would suit an active family with a backyard who can walk him daily and throw his favourite toy around, Ralph hasn't been exposed to an indoor setting as yet so may take some time adjusting but I think he will happily follow you around. His favourite game is showing his friends how quick his zoomies are so a nice backyard will do the trick so he can show off to you. If you're interested in hearing more about Ralph, please apply now.

NAME: Bruce
TEXT: Meet our big boy Bruce! He is a true delight to be around. He will make you laugh until you cackle. He will be happy to cruise around with you day in and out. He is a gorgeous character to boasts confidence. Bruce suffered a racing injury and required surgery on his front right leg so an experienced owner who knows when to slow down on the zoomies is ideal.

NAME: Moses
TEXT: Are you after a dog to be totally besotted by you? Well meet Moses, a quirky and loveable boy whose after his forever home. Moses boasts confidence and is extremely gentle in his approach. He has been around children 4+ and will request frequent pats. He has been brought up with a jack russel at home, but would benefit from a meet and greet prior to being adopted. Moses will be attending our Adoption Day at Glandore Wines on the 5th of October.

NAME: Stephen
TEXT: Meet Stephen ! a total sweetheart with a PhD in cuddling. 💙 Stephen is incredibly affectionate and absolutely adores people. He has a special love for his crate and all things soft and comfy, making him a champion napper and a joy to have indoors. While he’s social with medium to large dogs when out and about, Stephen would be happiest as the only dog in the home where he can soak up all the attention. Stephen has shown himself to be wonderful inside, so an apartment or quieter home where he can snooze on the couch and enjoy a relaxed routine would suit him perfectly. He has the potential to gradually work up to full-time hours, given time and patience. A home without kids, or with older, calm, and respectful children, would be ideal for this gentle soul. If you’re looking for a loving companion who’s all about comfort, closeness, and calm vibes, Stephen might just be your perfect match

NAME: Spot
TEXT: Spot is independent and enjoys spending time roaming around. Spot would suit a family who is after a companion to cruise around the backyard with. At times Spot can be weary and a bit timid in new environments but with the right re-assurance, she recovers really well. If you're interested in meeting our darling Spot, please apply now.

NAME: Julian
TEXT: Julian is best described as a distinguished gentleman. He is calm, friendly and an easy-going boy who just goes about his day without a fuss. He's walked around busy streets, schools, shopping centres as well as farms and paddocks. Nothing much fazes Julian, including other large dogs, small dogs and children. He loves people and pats and loves a walk, rarely pulling. Julian would suit most households and make a very special and loving companion who wants to be with you.

NAME: Gus
TEXT: Meet Gus: The Gentle Soul Gus is a serene and soft-natured Greyhound who thrives in a calm and loving environment. His gentle demeanor and shy personality make him a unique and endearing companion for the right home. Gus may be a bit reserved at first, but his gentle nature shines through once he feels comfortable. He’s the kind of dog who appreciates a quiet and patient approach, revealing his sweet personality in a calm and loving setting. Gus thrives in a peaceful environment where he can feel secure and relaxed. He’s not a fan of loud noises or bustling activities, so a tranquil home is ideal for him. Despite his shy nature, Gus is friendly and gets along well with other dogs. He enjoys their company and can be a great addition to a home with existing canine companions. If you’re looking for a sweet, soft-natured Greyhound who will flourish in a calm, loving home, Gus is the perfect match. He’s ready to bring his gentle presence and quiet companionship into your life.

NAME: Sub
TEXT: Sub is a joyful greyhound whose enthusiasm and positive energy are truly contagious. She approaches each day with a wagging tail and a bright smile, spreading happiness wherever she goes. She is a high-energy girl who thrives on regular physical activity. Her zest for life is evident in her love for playtime and her eagerness to engage in various activities. Sub absolutely adores zoomies! She loves to let loose and sprint around her playful bursts of speed are a sight to behold. Sub is a vibrant and spirited greyhound looking for an energetic home where her zest for life can shine. If you’re ready to embrace her joyful nature and provide a dynamic environment, Sub is eager to become your new best friend!

NAME: Corene
TEXT: Corene carries herself with a natural poise and assurance. She navigates new environments and situations with a calm self-assuredness that makes her a standout companion. Corene loves to stay on the move. Whether it’s a brisk walk, a run in the park, or playtime in the backyard, she’s always ready for an adventure. Corene’s curiosity knows no bounds. She’s always exploring her surroundings with an eager eye, making sure she’s aware of all that’s happening around her. Corene gets along well with medium and large dogs. She’s confident and social, but her interactions are best suited for companions of similar size and energy levels. Smaller dogs may find her enthusiasm overwhelming. Corene is a spirited and delightful greyhound ready to bring her energy and enthusiasm into a loving home. If you’re looking for a confident and active companion, Corene might be the perfect match for you!

NAME: Bailey
TEXT: Are you looking for a new furry companion to help bring out of their shell? Bailey would be the ideal companion for you! Bailey is our beautiful nervous nelly, he loves his routine and the people he is around all the time, but new people can make him revert into his greyhound bubble. Bailey is searching for home that is quiet and will allow him the time to really show off his personality. He would suit an avid Knights fan as he enjoys spending his Sunday afternoons by the TV, Bailey enjoys basking in the sunshine and having a splash at the beach. He is currently living inside/outside and is quiet and relaxed, he is okay to be left alone so long as he is in his safe spot.

NAME: Sam
TEXT: Meet Sam! Sam is quite a character and cannot wait to be the newest member of your family. He is always eager to get in on the action and be part of all the fun. Sam isn't shy and will say to everyone he passes. He is quite the socialist, so your daily walks will consist of meeting and greeting everyone that strolls past. He is relatively strong on the lead but will settle into his stride when he gets going. The ideal home for this charming boy would be one with an active lifestyle to help him channel his abundant energy.

NAME: Zarva
TEXT: Meet Zavra! Zarva is a very sweet natured boy. He is very curious & interested in the world. He positively interacts with those around him; children & smaller dogs :) Zarva wants to be involved. He'll be happy doing almost about anything. Whether it's a family movie day or spending a day outside going on adventures :) Enquire now & arrange to meet Zarva!

NAME: Maisie
TEXT: Meet Maisie! She might have the age of a senior lady, but definitely doesn't show it! Maisie is sweet curious girl. Eager to explore & learn. She might take a little while to warm up but once she does, she is full of character. Maisie would be best suited to a home with bigger dogs only, or a single dog home. Older kids to play with her preferred. Maisie would become a very loyal part of your home once settled & feeling comfortable :)

NAME: Chickadee
TEXT: Meet Chickadee, a friendly and playful, loving gentleman who is ready to meet his new family. This delightful dog is known for his fun-loving and amiable personality, and he's eager to share his heart with a compassionate, affectionate family. Chickadee has a wonderful rapport with children, especially those 8 years and older. He's not the sort who will tire out your kids with endless games of fetch, but prefers to spend time in children's company, quietly keeping them company while they do their homework or read stories. He loves leaning into a hearty pat and will choose to cuddle up next to you over toys any day. An interesting fact about Chickadee is that while he is a dog, he prefers the company of humans over other dogs. He's quite selective with his canine friends and might come off as aloof with dogs, particularly the smaller ones, which makes him ideally suited for a home where he can be the only pet. Chickadee is looking to bring his friendly and playful nature into a family who will offer him the same kindness and playfulness that he offers others in spades. He's ready for the next step and hopes to find a loving, forever home with a protective family to cherish him.

NAME: Alley
TEXT: Meet Alley, our friendly, senior female pup with a heart as golden as her years. Despite her age, Alley still carries a spark of puppyish charm in her eyes, making everyday feel like an adventure. Alley possesses the superb ability to bring life and joy into any room, with her boundless affection and unwavering loyalty. Well-socialised and incredibly friendly, Alley has had a great rapport with other small dogs and her fellow greyhounds. Her gentle and easygoing nature means she can find common ground with just about any dog she meets. She has even been socialised with cats and could probably coexist peacefully with the right feline friend. Alley's age doesn't slow her down. She has the physical agility of a much younger dog and loves playtime and walkies as much as curling up for a nap. Alley enjoys her walks and would be a wonderful companion to explore the neighbourhood parks with. Her ability to make friends so easily would also mean plenty of playdates with other dogs! As Alley's future family, you will be cherished with her loving gaze and affectionate rubs. If you're in search of an older, wiser pup who still knows how to have fun like a youngster, Alley just might be the loving companion you've been waiting for. Come meet her and let her amiable spirit brighten up your life!

NAME: Meg
TEXT: Meg is the epitome of gentle charm, with a touch of bashfulness that adds to his irresistible appeal. This shy guy isn't just looking for any home; he's on a quest for his own private sanctuary, where he can be the star of the show without any pesky co-stars stealing his spotlight. Meg's motto? "One dog, one throne!" He's not one for sharing his kingdom, but he'll gladly share his love with respectful children who understand the art of giving him space but love when he likes. With Meg around, every day is an adventure filled with quiet moments of contemplation, punctuated by bursts of zoomies when no one's looking. So, if you're ready to welcome a regal greyhound into your castle and bask in the glory of his majestic presence then Meg is the dashing companion you've been searching for. Contact our Western Sydney facility to arrange a meet and greet and get ready to embark on a journey of laughter, love, and endless tail wags with this shy but lovable boy!

NAME: Sandy
TEXT: Introducing Sandy, a beautiful and gentle girl who is ready to bring a ton of joy into your life! Known for her soft and gentle demeanor, Sandy possesses the ability to fill any room with calmness and love. Sandy is not just a dog; she's a friend and companion. Her kind and loving nature ensures that she gets along beautifully with both children and other dogs. She is known for her soft, soulful eyes that seem to look straight into your heart. What Sandy would love the most is a family that showers her with the same affection that she effortlessly gives to others. In her new home, Sandy would enjoy a cozy corner to curl up in, a safe garden to explore, and a family that she can love and be loved by. Sandy is just waiting to create numerous wonderful memories with a family who adores her. She promises a lifetime of love and dedication to those who welcome her into their heart.

NAME: Wighton
TEXT: Hello! My name is Wighton. I was known as Four Five on the racing tracks, but I hung up my racing collar late last year. I'm a courteous fellow, though I may take a little time to open up. Once I'm comfortable, I love to display my energetic zoomies. I've encountered several small dogs and they don't pique my interest much. I'm looking for a home with a backyard where I can have some space to myself from time to time. And, if you could take me on walks, that would be wonderful. I am looking forward to meeting my new human companions, so be sure to hit the 'apply' button when you can.

NAME: Lara
TEXT: Meet Lara! Lara hails from a sociable household where she has interacted with a Maltese terrier and frequently plays her fellow hound siblings. Initially, Lara may appear somewhat reserved, but with a touch of affection, care, and cuddles, she quickly warms up. She tends to be indifferent towards smaller dogs, often seeking reassurance from humans when they are present. With a lively spirit, Lara would be thrilled if her new human friends could take her on walks to let her energy out. Hit apply today to chat about your possible new addition.

NAME: Miss Ling
TEXT: Miss Ling is a big snuggle bunny. She is sweet and affectionate and will seek out affection Described as a happy girl she will bring a ray of sunshine to your life and be happy to be by your side through thick and thin. Miss Ling may be on the other side of 9 but she still has a lot of love to share and is looking for the right person to shower her love on

NAME: Luna
TEXT: Say hello to Luna, a sociable and friendly female dog who is sure to win your heart. Luna's radiant persona lights up every room she enters, and her charming nature has a contagious effect that brightens up everyone around her. Luna's love for people is truly one of her fine characteristics. She adores being in the company of humans and is a strong advocate for endless belly rubs, cuddles, and ear scratches. She thrives off attention and relishes in making every moment delightful for you, and herself of course. Interactive playtime is Luna's favorite! She gets immense joy out of chasing toys, whether it's a game of fetch or squeaky toys that catch her attention. This playful activity helps Luna stimulate her mind and use her attentive nature to the best of her abilities. In a dog community, Luna prefers the companionship of medium to large breed dogs. She blends well with her fellow canine mates, her easygoing nature allowing her to adapt quickly to their play style. This adaptability makes her the perfect addition to a family with a medium to large breed dog. In stepping into Luna's life, be prepared for an overflow of love and memorable moments. Luna is ready to love her new family wholeheartedly, and promises to bring with her a bundle of joy, laughter, and playful adventures.

NAME: Toby
TEXT: Nightmare? Bad dream? Don't worry, sometimes names ARE deceiving, because our boy Toby, former Race Name Scary Dream, is anything but scary! ✅ Beautiful nature, a genuinely sweet duffer ✅ Big softie: this boy is your quintessential "gentle giant." He does get excited, but is very kind-hearted and means well. ✅ Very friendly and human social. Nothing makes him happier than being with his people. ✅ Loves hopping on the lounge and laying with you. Disclaimer: he's big and likes to hog most of the couch space! ✅ Enjoys playing, having fun, and just living his best life ✅ He can be exuberant and boisterous to start (oh my god life is so exciting!!) - but he does settle and eventually wants to find a lounge. ✅ Has been living inside his current home everyday - and is becoming quite accustomed to the spoils of pet life! ✅ Like most men, Toby LOVES his food! This will help with training as he is very easily influenced when free food is on offer! ✅ This patient boy settles when in the car or trailer ✅ Best suited as the only dog in the household - more attention for Toby 😉 ✅ The only hound Toby wouldn't mind sharing his new forever home with is his sister-from-another-mister: Winnie (Microchip: 956000009482109). - They currently live inside together and don't mind sharing all the love and attention. - Winnie is also available for adoption: https://www.gapnsw.com.au/our-greyhounds/winnie-2 Toby will need a bit of time to settle into his new home - it's a big transition moving to a new house. But with a bit of love and patience, you will be rewarded with a sweet, but funny, but lovable larrikin. Toby hasn't had the chance to interact with children yet. So would need a nice meet and greet to see how everybody goes, if potentially going into a home with kids. He is a big strong boy so likely would be best with older children. This sturdy lad is strong on lead - there's a big world out there and oh so little time, Toby feels like he must concur it stat! He does settle, and with a little training and patience will be a good walking companion or social wing man. Toby will be 6 at the end of January! Nothing bonds a family and new boy better than a birthday party right?!

NAME: Marn
TEXT: Make room!! The Big Marn is here! He may bump around a little bit due to his left eye corneal abnormality, but he does it in style! With the former Race Name "Son Of Thirty," Marn could be your very own Son - and he'll never grow up to talk back to you or sneak out the window! In fact, he is a beautiful boy: ✅ This gorgeous lad is used to his current owner calling him "Handsome" and has requested this nickname continue in his new home ;) ✅ Loves people! He will seek out attention so get ready to give some affection (he'll give you ample back don't worry) ✅ Marn has met Geese, ducks and a cat and was well behaved (he did remain on his lead and muzzled for these interactions) ✅ Good with other dogs: - Settled well with a blind West Highland Terrier, but would benefit from a bit more work with small dogs. - Regularly interacts extremely well with other Greyhounds. - He would still need very slow, gradual introductions to any new dogs. ✅ Good with older children: - Marn has only interacted with kids aged 6+ years old. - He hasn't had the chance to interact with younger children yet, so would need a nice meet and greet first to see how everybody goes. ✅ Always a gentleman, Marn is very clean and quiet when kennelled and currently lives with three other greyhounds. Poor Ol' Marn does suffer from Pannus, mainly in his left eye, and will require ongoing treatment. This is easily managed and the GAP team will always provide advice and answer any questions or concerns you may have.

NAME: Luna
TEXT: Check out the pretty girl we have for you! You won't regret meeting the gorgeous Luna (former Race Name: Marion's Regret). We're not sure what Marion was regretting because it certainly wouldn't be this perfect lass: ✅ Socialite Luna looooooves people! She seeks out interaction and attention. But she definitely knows how to make you feel appreciated and loved back. ✅ Helpful Luna jumps in the car herself and travels very well - so get ready for some road trips! ✅ Luna the Lady is a lovely house guest: she is very clean in her kennel, doesn't chew her bed, and doesn't bark. ✅ Loopy Luna does commit zoomies and thoroughly enjoys them! ✅ She also loves to chase toys so get your throwing arm ready! ✅ Ever the investigator, Luna is also more than happy to roam the yard and inspect all the news and smells. ✅ Even Lunas need downtime, and she does love nothing more than sitting on her couch on the veranda, surveying her lands and taking in the fresh air and vitamin D. ✅ Great with kids. Luna frequently interacts and is fine with children aged 5+ years. ✅ Good with other dogs: - Luna was a little shy at first when she met a small Italian Greyhound. She had no issues, just a bit standoffish. However she did soon settle and was fine. - Free-ranges in the yard with a male Greyhound housemate. - Regularly interacts with other Greyhounds. - She didn't like when dogs got in her face (I think we can all appreciate a bit of personal space!) but settled and was able to play and interact. - Luna would need very slow, gradual introductions to any new dogs or potential doggie housemates Yes, she does appear to have a massive tongue! This fair-haired maiden turns 6 years old very soon! How convenient - you can throw both a "Welcome To Your New Home" AND "Birthday" party for her 😉

NAME: Tori
TEXT: Looking to spruce up your abode? We have some styling tips: Simply add the stunning Tori aka "Rattlin' Style" into your house! You'll be all the fashion and talk of the town! This strikingly elegant and beautiful girl has other lovely qualities too: ✅ Very affectionate little lady who thrives on human companionship. ✅ Good with older children: - Tori currently interacts with children aged 6+years old - She is relaxed and calm around older kids. She recognizes their gentle and caring presence, and her natural instincts guide her to be extra gentle and patient. - Tori is the kind of dog who will offer a warm nuzzle or a gentle paw to her young humans, ensuring an unbreakable bond. ✅ Tori is a good, polite girl in her kennel. ✅ This clever lass has an understanding of appropriate conduct and is respectful of boundaries. ✅ Good with Medium-Large breed dogs: - Regularly interacts with other Greyhounds. - Tori interacts best with male Greyhounds. - She would need very slow, gradual introductions to any new dogs. ✅ Tori loves her toys! Watching her play is a joy in itself. Her evident fun and energy is contagious! - so both Tori and you can have a grand old time! Tori will need a fully fenced yard. Tori can sometimes Resource Guard her food, so it is best if she is fed separately and left alone to eat her dins. If having a devoted dame in your life sounds like a pretty picture, then Enquire or Apply to Adopt Tori (Rattlin' Style) to style up your home 😉 She may just improve your life and happiness too!
